title: Social Media Content & Growth Lead
description:
Party & Presents is a personalized party and gifting brand based in Canada. We create custom party decor, favors, wedding products, and other personalized celebration items.



We’re looking for a creative Social Media Content & Growth Lead to take ownership of our organic social media and help us grow awareness, engagement, and sales.



This is NOT just a posting/scheduling role.



We need someone who can look at our products and turn them into content people actually want to watch, save, share and buy from.



What you’ll do:



- Develop content ideas and social media strategy

- Research trends on TikTok, Instagram and Pinterest

- Create Reels, TikToks, carousels, Stories and graphics

- Edit short-form video using CapCut, Premiere or similar

- Use Canva to create strong social content

- Write hooks, captions and CTAs

- Turn existing product photos/videos into multiple content pieces

- Give our Canadian production team clear shot lists and filming direction

- Plan and manage the content calendar

- Publish across Instagram, TikTok,
 and 

- Track what performs best and adjust the strategy based on data



Example content we want to create:



“8 Kids’ Birthday Themes We Think Will Be Everywhere This Fall”

“Party Favors Kids Will Actually Be Excited to Get”

“Watch Us Turn This Photo Into Party Decor”

“Wedding Favors Guests Will Actually Use”

“POV: Your Husband Said He Didn’t Want a Big Deal Made About Turning 40…”



Who we’re looking for:



- Strong creative instincts and visual taste

- Good Canva/design skills

- Strong short-form video editing skills

- Understands TikTok/Reels and what makes people stop scrolling

- Good at research, hooks and storytelling

- Can work independently and come up with ideas without waiting for the founder

- Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and brainstorm better

- Strong written English

- Organized, proactive and analytical



Bonus if you have experience with:



E-commerce or physical-product brands

Pinterest

Etsy or Shopify

UGC/influencer content

Social analytics

Photography or creative direction

title: VP of Outbound Sales
description:
About Us

At 
, we provide top-quality cabinetry and building materials to our customers. We are currently expanding our global sales footprint and are looking for a highly driven and experienced VP of Outbound Sales based in the Philippines. You will be the cornerstone of our outbound efforts, tasked with building, scaling, and optimizing a high-performing cold-calling sales team.



The Role

As the VP of Outbound Sales, you will own the end-to-end performance of our outbound sales division. We are not just looking for a manager; we need a strategic builder who can establish metrics, write the playbook, and inspire a team of cold callers to exceed their revenue targets. Your core focus will be day-to-day team leadership, ongoing coaching, talent acquisition, and strategic team development.



Key Responsibilities

Day-to-Day Leadership: Actively manage and motivate a dedicated team of outbound cold callers, driving high daily activity levels and ensuring maximum productivity.



Process & Strategy Creation: Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the entire sales cycle, from the opening pitch to closing the deal.



KPI Management: Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure team success, identify bottlenecks, and optimize call conversion rates.



Training & Coaching: Conduct regular call listening sessions, role-playing, and one-on-one coaching to continuously elevate the team's sales skills and product knowledge.



Recruitment & Scaling: Lead the hiring, interviewing, and onboarding of new sales representatives to scale the department.



Strategic Advising: Analyze floor performance and provide actionable management recommendations to executive leadership regarding staffing, tools, and market approach.



Qualifications

Experience: Minimum of 3 years of proven experience specifically managing and leading outbound cold-calling sales teams.



Industry Knowledge: Previous experience in the building materials, home improvement, or cabinetry industry is highly preferred.



Systematic Approach: Demonstrated ability to build sales frameworks from scratch, including drafting SOPs and establishing performance dashboards.



Leadership Skills: Strong capability in recruiting, training, and mentoring sales talent with a track record of driving teams to meet aggressive quotas.



Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to negotiate and close effectively.



Compensation & Benefits

Base + Override Commission: This role offers a highly competitive base salary paired with a lucrative commission structure based on the total sales of your entire team. Your earning potential scales directly with your leadership and your team's success.



Growth Opportunities: As an early leader in this division, you will have significant influence over the company's sales trajectory and room for career expansion.

title: Provider Relations & Operations Coordinator
description:
Provider Relations & Operations Coordinator



Company: EverCare Placement — Arizona, USA

Role Type: Part-Time to Start — 20–25 Hours/Week

Schedule: Monday–Friday with required overlap during Arizona business hours

Location: Remote — Philippines

Compensation: Based on experience

Long-Term Growth Opportunity



About EverCare



EverCare Placement is a fast-growing senior care navigation and placement company based in Arizona.



Families come to us when they need help navigating assisted living, memory care, residential care homes and other senior-care resources. Our team helps families understand their options, coordinates with providers and supports them throughout the process.



As EverCare continues to grow, we are strengthening our Operations team and looking for someone who is highly organized, technically capable, proactive and extremely reliable.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



This is a core Operations role with significant responsibility and opportunity for growth.



Position Overview



We are hiring a Provider Relations & Operations Coordinator who will help manage several critical areas of EverCare's operations, including:



Contracting with senior living communities and residential care homes

Provider relationship management and follow-up

Maintaining accurate provider and contract information

CRM and database administration

Supporting our placement advisors

Airtable and Notion administration

Documenting company workflows and creating SOPs

Operational reporting and accountability

Improving internal systems and processes



You will work closely with our existing Operations team and company leadership.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply complete assigned tasks.



We want someone who takes ownership.



If something is incomplete, you follow up.



If something is inaccurate, you correct it.



If something is stuck, you communicate it.



If a process isn't documented, you document it.



If you see a better way to accomplish something, we want to hear it.



Primary Responsibilities

1. Contracting & Provider Relations



You will help manage EverCare's contracting pipeline from initial contact through completed agreement.



Responsibilities include:



Contact senior living communities and residential care homes

Communicate with Executive Directors, Sales Directors, owners and other professionals

Send contracts and required documentation

Follow up consistently on outstanding agreements

Track the status of every active contract

Identify missing signatures, documents or information

Upload and organize completed agreements

Maintain accurate contract terms and provider information

Escalate stalled contracts when necessary

Build professional relationships with our provider partners



Your responsibility is not simply to send a contract.



Your responsibility is to help get the contract completed.



2. Provider Database Management



EverCare maintains a growing database of senior living and care providers throughout Arizona.



You will help ensure this information remains accurate, organized and useful.



Responsibilities include:



Add new providers

Update provider contacts and leadership information

Verify phone numbers and contact information

Update pricing and care information

Verify services and availability when requested

Identify duplicate or outdated records

Maintain accurate contract statuses

Research new providers entering our markets

Help maintain Preferred Provider and Do Not Use information

Review available public information regarding licensing or regulatory changes when necessary



Our team relies on this information when helping real families make important decisions. Accuracy matters.



3. Airtable, CRM & Systems



EverCare uses several technology platforms to manage our business.



You will work with systems including:



Airtable

Notion

GoHighLevel

Google Workspace

Senior-care industry software

Workflow and automation tools

Airtable experience is required.



You should understand more than simply entering information into Airtable.



You should be comfortable with concepts such as:



Tables and databases

Linked records

Views and filters

Forms

Formulas

Basic automations

Data organization

Troubleshooting workflows



You do not need to be an Airtable developer, but you should be capable of understanding an existing Airtable environment and learning how its workflows and automations function.



Experience with Notion, GoHighLevel, Zapier or Make is highly desirable.



4. SOPs & Process Documentation



As you learn EverCare's systems, you will also help document how the company operates.



This is an important part of the position.



Responsibilities include:



Learn existing workflows from team members

Document recurring operational processes

Create clear step-by-step SOPs

Document Airtable workflows and automations

Maintain organized process documentation in Notion

Update SOPs when processes change

Identify undocumented processes

Create checklists where appropriate

Help ensure critical company processes can be understood and performed by more than one team member



Our goal is to build systems that are organized, scalable and not dependent on one person's knowledge.



5. Agent & Operations Support



Our placement advisors need accurate information and responsive operational support.



You may assist with:



Researching providers

Confirming provider information

Locating agreements and documents

Resolving missing contract information

Preparing information for agents

Correcting inaccurate database records

Following up with providers

Supporting administrative needs related to active placements



You should enjoy being the person who helps bring organization and resolution to operational problems.



6. Operational Reporting



Leadership needs visibility into what is happening without having to chase people for updates.



You will help maintain clear reporting regarding:



Contracts sent

Contracts completed

Outstanding contracts

Stalled contracts

Missing documentation

Provider records requiring updates

Outstanding operational issues

Completed projects

Current priorities

System or workflow problems



You should always be able to answer:



What is the status?

What is missing?

Who owns the next step?

When was the last follow-up?

What happens next?



ENGLISH & COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS

Excellent spoken English is REQUIRED.



This is a phone-based professional position.



You will regularly communicate with senior living executives, healthcare professionals, business owners, referral partners and EverCare team members in the United States.



You must:



Speak fluent, clear and easily understood English

Be confident having professional conversations with Americans

Communicate naturally rather than sounding like you are reading from a script

Have excellent listening comprehension

Write professional
s and messages

Be comfortable asking questions and clarifying information

Be confident making outbound calls every day



A voice recording is mandatory for consideration.



Applicants who do not demonstrate strong spoken English will not move forward in the interview process regardless of other qualifications.



What We Expect

Reliability



If you are scheduled to work, we expect you to be available and responsive.



You must:



Maintain consistent working hours

Communicate when stepping away

Respond to internal messages promptly during working hours

Communicate problems before they become emergencies

Meet deadlines without repeated reminders

Have reliable internet and a backup internet solution

Ownership



We don't want someone who waits to be told every next step.



We want someone who thinks:



"What needs to happen next to get this completed?"



Strong follow-through is one of the most important qualities we're looking for.



Organization



You should be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Consistent

Persistent

Comfortable managing many open items simultaneously

Comfortable prioritizing urgent work

Capable of maintaining accurate records

Able to document your work clearly

Required Qualifications

Excellent spoken and written English

Professional and confident phone presence

Airtable experience

Experience with CRM or database systems

Strong computer and technology skills

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organizational skills

Comfortable making outbound calls

Ability to learn new software quickly

Ability to work independently

Reliable internet connection with backup

Quiet, professional workspace

Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based company

Strongly Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Notion

GoHighLevel

Zapier

Make

Google Workspace

CRM administration

Workflow automation

SOP/process documentation

Contract administration

Project coordination

Healthcare administration

Senior living

U.S. healthcare



Healthcare experience is helpful but not required.



We can teach our industry. We cannot teach reliability, ownership or work ethic.



Schedule



This position will begin at approximately 20–25 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



You must have consistent availability overlapping with Arizona business hours (Mountain Standard Time).



There is an opportunity for increased hours, responsibility and compensation as you demonstrate your capabilities and EverCare continues to grow.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone interested in building a career with EverCare — not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.



A strong performer may eventually take on substantially greater responsibility for:



Company operations

Systems administration

Airtable

Automations

Process management

Reporting

Team support



There is significant opportunity to grow with the company.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



EVERCARE OPERATIONS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



Please submit:



1. Updated Resume



Include your most recent work experience.



2. Voice Recording — REQUIRED



Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Please tell us:



Your name

Your professional background

Your experience working with U.S. companies

Why you believe you would be a good fit for this position



Do not read a prepared script.



We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



3. Airtable Experience



Rate your Airtable experience from 1–10 and briefly describe what you have personally built, managed or maintained.



Please specifically mention any experience with:



Linked records

Automations

Formulas

Interfaces/views

Forms

Database design



4. Systems Experience



Tell us about your experience with:



Airtable

Notion

GoHighLevel or other CRMs

Zapier / Make

Google Workspace



5. Ownership Question



Tell us about a previous job where you were responsible for making sure something actually got completed — not simply completing one assigned step.



What were you responsible for and how did you keep track of everything?



6. Process Documentation



Have you created SOPs or documented business processes before?



Give us an example.



7. Current Employment



What other jobs, clients, freelance projects or ongoing work commitments do you currently have?



8. Availability



Provide your Monday–Friday availability expressed in Arizona time (MST).



9. Compensation



What hourly rate are you requesting in USD?



10. Internet



Provide a current Speedtest.net screenshot and describe your backup internet solution.



Final Scenario



Imagine you join EverCare and inherit a contracting database containing 300 senior-care providers.



Some contracts are completed.



Some are pending.



Some providers have stopped responding.



Some records are missing documents.



Some information is outdated.



Several automations and workflows already exist, but another team member currently understands them better than you do.



Your manager asks:



"Within 30 days, I want you to understand this system, help clean it up, document how it works, and be able to tell me exactly where every contract stands."



In 10 sentences or less, explain how you would approach your first 30 days.



We care much more about how you think, communicate and take ownership than giving us a perfect answer.

description:
We are an established U.S.-based architectural services firm looking for Architectural Designers to join our remote production team in the Philippines on a part-time, project-based basis.



This position focuses specifically on converting 3D laser scan and point cloud data of existing buildings into accurate architectural CAD drawings.



Responsibilities:



- Create accurate architectural floor plans in AutoCAD from 3D point cloud scan data

- Interpret existing building conditions from scan data

- Accurately draw walls, doors, windows, stairs, columns, fixtures, and other architectural elements

- Follow established company CAD standards and drawing procedures

- Review your own work for accuracy and completeness

- Complete assigned projects within established production schedules



Requirements:



- Bachelor's degree in Architecture (BS Architecture, B.Arch, or equivalent) is required

- Expert-level AutoCAD skills

- Strong understanding of architectural drawings and existing building conditions

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Excellent spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work independently and follow established standards

- Good written English communication

- Reliable computer and internet connection



Preferred Experience:



Previous experience with 3D point clouds, LiDAR, laser scanning, as-built documentation, or Scan-to-CAD workflows is highly preferred but not required. Training on our specific workflow will be provided.



Position & Compensation:



This is an ongoing, part-time, project-based position.



Compensation is paid per completed project based on the size and complexity of each assignment. Compensation and expected production time are established prior to hiring.



Efficient designers who consistently produce accurate work will have opportunities to receive additional projects and increase their overall workload.



We are looking to develop long-term relationships with talented architectural professionals who can become regular members of our production team.

Your resume

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Outbound Sales
description:
About Us


 is a premier provider of high-quality cabinetry, selling nationwide across the United States. We are rapidly expanding our global sales force and are looking for relentless, highly motivated Outbound Sales Associates to join our team in the Philippines. If you are hungry for success and want to control your own earning potential, this is the place for you.



The Role

This is a pure hunter role. We are looking for fearless, proactive sales professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment. Your primary objective will be to get on the phones, generate interest, and close deals with customers across North America. You will be making hundreds of outbound cold calls on a daily basis, acting as the frontline voice of 
.

High-Volume Prospecting: Execute hundreds of outbound cold calls daily to prospective customers in the United States.



Pitching & Closing: Clearly and confidently communicate our value proposition, educate customers on our cabinetry products, and close sales over the phone.



Pipeline Management: Track your calls, follow-ups, and customer interactions diligently within our CRM system.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
I'm looking for a **long-term short-form video editor** to help edit content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form platforms.



I create a high volume of short-form content, and I'm looking for someone who can eventually take raw footage from me and turn it into a finished video without needing constant direction.



### What you'll be editing



Most videos will involve:



- Cutting talking-head footage and removing dead space

- Adding captions/text when appropriate

- Adding images, screenshots, graphics, and other visual overlays

- Finding and adding relevant B-roll

- Creating simple B-roll/product-focused videos

- Adding sound effects and music when appropriate

- Simple zooms, crops, punch-ins, and other retention edits

- Making sure the visuals support **what is actually being said**

- Keeping videos fast-paced without making them feel over-edited



I care much more about **good pacing, visual storytelling, and attention to detail** than crazy effects or complicated transitions.



A big part of this job is understanding what I'm talking about and figuring out what should visually appear on screen to make the video more entertaining and easier to understand.



### What I'm looking for



You should have:



- Strong English comprehension

- Experience editing short-form vertical content

- Strong attention to detail

- A good understanding of TikTok/Reels pacing

- The ability to follow a reference style closely

- The ability to find appropriate B-roll/images when needed

- Good communication

- Reliable internet

- Ability to receive feedback and implement it consistently

- **[CapCut / DaVinci Resolve / Premiere Pro — whichever you want to require]**



You don't need to be the world's most advanced editor.



I'm looking for someone who is **reliable, learns quickly, communicates well, and can learn my editing style.**



## IMPORTANT — Recreate Assignment



**Please do not apply without completing this.**



I want to see how closely you can replicate my editing style.



**Finished Reference Video:**







**Raw Files:**







Using the raw footage provided, **recreate the reference video as closely as possible.**



Try to match:



- Cuts and pacing

- Text/captions

- B-roll and images

- Zooms/crops

- Visual timing

- Overall editing style



The goal isn't to make your own version.



**The goal is to show me how accurately you can recreate mine.**



When finished, send:



1. Your recreated video

2. A link to your portfolio or 2–3 examples of your best short-form work

3. Your typical availability

4. Your desired rate

5. The editing software you use



Applicants who do well on the recreation assignment will be invited to a short video call.



I'm looking for someone I can work with **long-term**, so communication and reliability are just as important to me as editing ability.

Lane Fertility Institute is a U.S.-based fertility practice dedicated to providing high-quality, compassionate, and accessible fertility care.

Our ideal candidate is **warm, articulate, highly organized, confident on the phone, and excellent at follow-up**. You should genuinely enjoy speaking with people, explaining complex information clearly, and helping patients feel comfortable making important decisions about their care.



For the right person, we are looking to build a **long-term working relationship**.



## What You Will Do



You will be responsible for guiding prospective patients from their initial inquiry through consultation and treatment initiation. Your responsibilities will include:



* Contacting new patient inquiries promptly by phone,
, and text

* Building rapport with prospective patients and understanding their needs

* Scheduling new patient consultations

* Following up consistently with patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled or started treatment

* Explaining our fertility services and the general treatment process

* Helping patients understand our **Affordable IVF program**, insurance options, and self-pay pricing

* Explaining available payment options, including payment in full and in-house payment plans

* Helping patients understand what they need to complete before beginning treatment

* Maintaining communication with patients between their initial consultation and the start of their treatment cycle

* Collecting and uploading medical records and new patient documents

* Confirming that consultation fees have been paid before appointments

* Sending Zoom links and appointment information

* Maintaining accurate records of patient communications and follow-up

* Using professional interpreter/language-line services when assisting Spanish- or Mandarin-speaking patients



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



**An outstanding communicator.** You should speak and write English fluently and professionally and be comfortable having numerous telephone conversations throughout the workday.



**Warm and empathetic.** Fertility treatment can be emotional and stressful. Patients should feel that you are genuinely interested in helping them.



**Confident and persuasive.** Part of your role is helping patients move from interest to action. You should be comfortable following up, addressing concerns, discussing costs, and asking patients whether they are ready to schedule or begin treatment.



**Extremely organized.** You may be communicating with many patients at different stages of the process. Excellent documentation and follow-through are essential.



**Proactive.** We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions. We value team members who identify what needs to be done, prioritize it, and follow through.



**Comfortable discussing money.** You will regularly explain treatment costs and payment options. You must be able to have these conversations professionally and confidently.



**Interested in healthcare.** Previous fertility experience is not required, but healthcare, medical office, patient coordination, customer service, inside sales, or healthcare virtual-assistant experience is highly desirable.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful New Patient Coordinator does more than schedule appointments.



You will help ensure that prospective patients:



* Receive a prompt response when they contact our practice

* Feel welcomed and supported

* Understand their treatment and financial options

* Attend their scheduled consultations

* Know exactly what they need to do next

* Receive appropriate follow-up after their consultation

* Successfully move from consultation to treatment when they are ready



Your ability to communicate, follow up, and build trust will directly influence both the **patient experience and the growth of our practice**.



## Position Details



* **Location:** 100% remote

* **Practice:** U.S.-based fertility clinic

* **Schedule:** Full-time, working hours aligned with our U.S. clinic operations

* **Position Type:** Long-term

* **Compensation:** Competitive and based on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

* **Training:** Training will be provided on our fertility services, patient processes, financial options, and internal systems

* Work shifts: 5 am to 1 pm Eastern Standard Time; 12 noon to 8 pm Pacific Standard Time; 10 am to 6 pm Eastern Standard Time; with lunch breaks and 15 minute breaks during each shift



## Why Join Lane Fertility Institute?



You will be joining a small, mission-driven healthcare organization where your work has a visible impact.



You will not simply be completing administrative tasks. You will help patients who may have spent months or years trying to understand how they can afford and access fertility treatment. Your job is to make that process clearer, easier, and more personal.



We value **integrity, accountability, excellent communication, initiative, compassion, and follow-through**.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important and trusted member of our team—not someone looking for a short-term VA assignment.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction explaining why this position interests you.

2. A description of any experience you have in healthcare, patient coordination, customer service, sales, or appointment setting.

3. Your experience communicating with U.S.-based clients or patients, if applicable.

4. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.

5. A **60–90 second audio or video introduction** so we can hear how you communicate. Please introduce yourself and explain how you would reassure a prospective patient who is interested in fertility treatment but is nervous about the cost.



Please begin your application with the words **“Patient First”** so we know you have read the entire job description.



We look forward to hearing from you.



For OnlineJobs.ph specifically, I would **keep the audio/video requirement**. For this position, spoken English, warmth, confidence, and the ability to explain financial information naturally are probably more important than a polished résumé. The “Patient First” instruction will also help you immediately identify applicants who are mass-applying without reading the posting.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
e run Meta ads for home-services contractors across the US — roofing, remodeling, landscaping, ADU, construction. About 150 active clients. Our ads work; the reason clients stay or leave is almost entirely what happens after the leads start coming in.



That's this job. You own retention for the whole client base and you lead the Success Manager team that delivers it. This is a leadership seat, not a support role — you'll manage Success Managers, sit as the escalation point below the founders, and be the person who knows, before anyone asks, which clients are healthy, which are at risk, and why.



What you'll actually do



Own the retention number. Churn under 5% a month is the standard. You're accountable for it, and you'll have the authority to change how we work in order to hit it.



Lead the Success Manager pods. We run three — landscaping/outdoor, remodeling/construction, and miscellaneous trades — each with a Success Manager paired to a dedicated media buyer. You manage the SMs, set the standard, and coach them. You'll also carry a small book of key accounts yourself so you're never managing from a distance.



Enforce the client cadence. Every client gets a 30-minute recap call each month plus regular lead check-ins. Every call gets a written recap into the client group chat and ClickUp. No exceptions — the paper trail is non-negotiable, and you hold that line.



Run saves. When a client is unhappy or wants to cancel, you diagnose it and fix it: new creative, a new offer or angle, targeting and radius adjustments, a high-intent lead form, CRM and follow-up repairs, or coaching the client's own sales team on how they're working the leads. Then you follow up 24–48 hours later to confirm it actually landed.



Translate client problems into campaign changes. You work directly with the media buyers. "Leads are bad" isn't a report — you figure out why and hand the buyer something actionable.



Run onboarding calls. You'll take new clients through their first two calls and set expectations correctly from day one. Half of retention is won here.



Run exit meetings. When a client does leave, find the real reason and feed it back so we stop losing clients the same way twice.



Report up. Leadership should never learn about client health from a surprise.



One standing guardrail: refunds, credits, and free months always need founder approval before they're offered. Everything else, you run.



Who we're looking for



2+ years client-facing in account management, customer success, or agency client services. Paid media experience is a big plus.

Native or near-native English, on camera, comfortable with American contractors. Our clients are business owners who work with their hands — plainspoken beats polished, every time.

You've led people. Managed, mentored, or trained a team. You know how to hold someone to a standard without becoming the reason they quit.

You can read a Meta ads dashboard. You don't need to build campaigns, but you need to hold a real conversation about cost per lead, lead quality, spend, and pipeline stages — and know when a number means something is actually wrong.

CRM fluency. GoHighLevel is a major plus. ClickUp for tasks and recaps.

Ruthlessly organized. You'll run 25–35 calls a week across dozens of accounts. If threads drop, clients leave. Show us your system.

AI-forward. We use AI throughout the business and we're building internal tools. If you already use these tools daily to work faster, say so.



Nice to have: home services or contractor experience, Spanish, or a background in reporting, dashboards, and automation.

title: Coaching Operations & Marketing VA - Long-Term Role
description:
Hi,

I’m Phil, an Australian business owner and business coach working with established small-business owners.

My coaching business is growing and I’m looking for a really organised, proactive VA to work alongside me and help build the operational engine behind it.

This is not just a social media role and it’s not a role where I want to give someone a list of tasks every morning.

I’m looking for someone who notices things.

Someone who enjoys creating order, following things through and making sure good opportunities, relationships and ideas don’t fall through the cracks.

What you’ll help me with

CRM & relationship management

I meet a lot of business owners through networking, referrals, events and everyday conversations.

You’ll help me:

• Keep ActiveCampaign organised

• Add and update contacts

• Maintain useful notes and tags

• Track conversations and opportunities

• Create follow-up reminders

• Prepare weekly follow-up lists

• Help me stay connected with good people

• Make sure valuable relationships don’t disappear because I got busy



I want the CRM to be a useful relationship system - not simply a giant
 database.



Coaching client administration

You’ll help keep the administration around my coaching clients organised, including:

• Client records

• Coaching platform administration

• Session notes and actions

• Client resources

• Onboarding

• Forms and questionnaires

• Reminders

• Tracking outstanding actions

• Keeping information organised and current

I’ll always own the actual coaching and client relationship. Your role is to make the system around it run really well.



Content & social media

I create regular business coaching content.

You’ll help turn that content into consistent distribution across platforms such as:

• LinkedIn

•

• Instagram

• YouTube Shorts

• Google Business Profile

This could include scheduling posts, basic video/reel editing, captions, formatting, content organisation and helping manage engagement.

I’d love someone who understands how to take one good piece of content and distribute it effectively rather than constantly needing more content.



Outreach & research

You may also help with:

• Researching interesting regional businesses and founders

• Business feature/interview outreach

• LinkedIn research

• Networking follow-ups

• Referral opportunities

• Preparing personalised outreach for me to review/send

I’m much more interested in 10 thoughtful, relevant connections than 200 generic messages.



The person I’m looking for

The most important things to me are:

• Excellent organisation

• Very good written English

• Proactive rather than reactive

• Strong attention to detail

• Good judgement

• Comfortable working independently

• Experience supporting a founder, coach or small business

• CRM/database experience

• Social media/content management experience

• Comfortable learning new technology and using AI

• Reliable and consistent

Experience with ActiveCampaign is helpful but NOT essential.

If you’ve used another CRM well and understand how good CRM and follow-up systems work, I’m happy for you to learn ActiveCampaign.

Experience working with a business coach, consultant or founder would be particularly useful.



What working with me will be like

I’m relaxed and friendly, but I care about getting things done properly.

I value:

• Initiative

• Honesty

• Clear communication

• Simplicity

• Reliability

• Continuous improvement

I don’t want to micromanage you.

Over time, I’d love you to understand the business well enough that you start seeing things before I do.

Instead of:

“Phil, what should I do today?”

I’d love to hear:

“Phil, I noticed these three people need following up. I’ve updated the CRM and prepared the details for you. Sarah also mentioned she’d be hiring a manager in October, so I’ve created a reminder to reconnect with her then.”

That’s the kind of support I’m looking for.



Hours

Initially approximately 15 hours per week, with the potential to increase toward 20+ hours as the business grows.

I’m looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term part of the business rather than completing a short project.



How to apply

Please don’t send me a generic application.

Instead, answer the questions below. 

1. Tell me briefly about the founder, coach or business owner you’ve most enjoyed supporting. What did you actually do for them?

2. What CRM systems have you used and what were you responsible for?

3. Tell me about your experience managing or distributing social media content. Which platforms and tools have you used?

4. Scenario:

I send you this voice note after a networking event:

“Met James from ABC Plumbing today. Good bloke. 12 staff. Business is doing well but he’s working six days and struggling to get his supervisors to take ownership. Not ready for coaching right now, but definitely someone I’d like to stay connected with.”

What would you do with that information?

5. Give me an example of something you noticed and proactively fixed or improved without your employer specifically asking you to.

6. What hours are you currently available each week, and are you currently working for other clients?



Finally, start your application with the words “Calm Operator” so I know you’ve read the whole advertisement.

Sos end your resume plus your answers to the above as a cover letter. 



Thanks,

Phil

title: Short Form Video Editor + Ad Creative Editor
description:
We are Violate The Dress Code, a US based women's activewear brand built around doing things differently.



We already have the content. A LOT of it.



What we need is someone who can take our existing raw footage, product videos, photos, UGC, campaign content, and past winning ads and turn it into a consistent stream of scroll stopping creative for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.



This is NOT a position where we need someone to film content.



We need an editor who can look at a folder of footage and see 10 different ads hiding inside of it.



What you'll be doing:

* Editing short form video ads for Meta, Instagram, and TikTok

* Turning existing footage into multiple completely different ad concepts

* Creating strong hooks within the first few seconds

* Adding text, captions, product callouts, music, sound effects, and transitions when appropriate

* Creating different versions of winning ads by changing hooks, opening clips, pacing, copy, and CTAs

* Repurposing organic content into paid ads

* Occasionally creating simple motion graphics or animated static ads

* Following our existing brand style while also bringing new creative ideas to us

* Studying our best performing ads and creating new variations based on what is working

* Organizing completed creative so our team can easily test and launch it



What we're looking for:

You do NOT need a huge resume.

You DO need to be creative, fast, reliable, and willing to learn.



We want someone who:

* Understands short form content

* Knows how to grab attention quickly

* Understands that an ad needs to SELL, not just look pretty

* Can create multiple concepts from the same footage

* Has strong attention to detail

* Can follow a brand guide without making every ad look identical

* Understands current TikTok, Reels, and ecommerce editing styles

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Can work independently once given direction

* Communicates consistently

* Meets deadlines



Experience editing for ecommerce, fashion, activewear, fitness, beauty, or lifestyle brands is a BIG plus.

Experience with Meta ads or direct response advertising is an even bigger plus.



Editing software:

We don't care what program you use as long as you can create great work efficiently.

CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar programs are all welcome.



Hours:

We would like to start part time at approximately 15 to 20 hours per week.

There is potential for this position to grow as we build our creative system together.

We care more about consistent output and quality than watching a clock.



Starting compensation

$5 to $8 USD per hour depending on experience and portfolio.



This will begin with a paid trial project before we select someone for the ongoing position.



What success looks like:



We don't want one perfect video that takes an entire day to make.

We want someone who learns our brand well enough that we can hand you a folder of content and you can consistently turn it into multiple strong ads for us to test.



Some will win. Some won't. That's advertising.



The goal is to create enough GOOD creative that we can constantly test new hooks, angles, products, and ideas.



How to apply:



Please send us:

1. Your name and where you're located

2. A link to your portfolio

3. 3 examples of short form videos or advertisements you personally edited

4. Which editing programs you use

5. Your hourly rate

6. Approximately how many hours per week you're available

7. Any experience you have with ecommerce or paid social advertising



IMPORTANT:

Start your application with the words:



**I VIOLATE THE DRESS CODE**



Applications that do not start with this sentence will not be considered.



Then answer this question:

If we gave you one folder containing 20 clips of a model wearing a pair of leggings, how would you turn that footage into multiple different ads? Give us at least 3 different concepts.



We are not looking for the "perfect" answer. We want to see how you think creatively.



Please do not send a generic copy and paste application. We actually read these.

title: Ecommerce Content Scraper & Basic Video Editor

• Good organization with files, folders, source links, and naming conventions.

Experience leading a small team of editors is a bonus, but it is not required.

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads) - Lead Buyer for a US Home Services Agency



Company: Spark Marketing Agency Inc. Type: Full-time, remote, independent contractor Hours: US Pacific business hours Pay: $1,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience



About us



We are a US marketing agency. We run Meta ads for residential contractors: roofing, remodeling, landscaping, pools, siding, HVAC, and other home service trades.



We are not a small shop. We manage around 150 client accounts, split into three teams. Each team has a Success Manager and a Junior Media Buyer. We also have a full in-house video team that films real content for our clients anywhere in the US.



Our clients are real businesses spending real money. Some of them have made over a million dollars from the ads we run. We take that seriously.



The role



This is the senior media buying seat. You sit above the three teams and you own ad performance across the whole agency.



Three things you will be responsible for:



1. Oversee all client ad accounts. You review what the Junior Media Buyers are running. You catch problems before the client does. You set the rules for how we build campaigns, how we test creative, and when we scale or kill something. When an account is losing money, you are the one who fixes it.



2. Train the Junior Media Buyers. You are their coach. You review their work, you tell them what to change and why, and you make them better every month. If a junior is not improving, you tell us early.



3. Run our own ads. Spark runs its own Meta campaigns to get new clients. You will own that account. This is the account that pays everyone's salary, so it gets your best work.



What we need from you

3+ years buying Meta ads, most of it agency side

Real experience with home services or contractor clients. This is not optional. If you have only run e-commerce or info products, this is not the right seat for you.

You have managed multiple accounts at once and did not let the small ones rot

You can read a numbers report and tell us what is actually wrong, not just what the numbers say

You have trained or reviewed other buyers before

You understand lead quality, not just lead cost. A $9 lead that never answers the phone is worse than a $40 lead that books a job.

Comfortable in Meta Business Manager at the portfolio level: assets, permissions, pixels, domains, all of it

You can write in clear English and speak on a call without needing a script

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle a full workday

You can work US Pacific business hours. This means night shift in the Philippines. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to that.



Nice to have, not required: GoHighLevel, Google Ads, and experience working with a video or creative team.



What we are not looking for



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to duplicate ad sets and raise budgets. We are not looking for someone who needs a manager checking on them every day. And we are not looking for someone who blames the creative, the client, or the algorithm every time an account goes sideways.



We want someone who owns the number.



Pay and growth



$1,500 to $3,500 USD per month, paid based on what you actually bring. If you have run contractor accounts at scale and can prove it, you will land at the top of that range.



This is a long-term seat. We are growing, and the person in this role grows with us.



How to apply



Three steps. If you skip one, we will not review your application.



1. Send a Loom video, 5 minutes or less. Walk us through one real ad account you have run for a home service or contractor client. Show us the account if you can. Tell us what was broken, what you changed, and what happened after. Do not sell yourself. Just show us the work.



2. Send your numbers.



How many accounts you have managed at one time

Total ad spend you have managed, per month at your peak

Two or three client results you are proud of, with real numbers

The worst account you ever had and what you did about it



3. Fill out the application form. 



Put "SENIOR BUYER" in the subject line of your application.



We read every application that follows these three steps. Applications without a Loom video get deleted.



Talk soon, Cesar Founder, Spark Marketing Agency

One thing to know upfront: the footage library gets reused. Once a clip is done, that material stays in play for future ones. So part of the job is finding fresh angles in footage we have already cut from. Different moments, different pacing, a different idea. If you can only make something good the first time you see a clip, this is not the right fit.

**WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR**



A genuine self starter. You bring ideas, you do not just execute tasks.



Actually plugged into the Instagram algorithm in the US and Canada. What is trending this week, not last quarter.



Fast, clean editing. Sharp cuts, good pacing, sound design that lands.



Solid color correction. This one is not optional. The footage needs grading and it has to look consistent across a batch.



Adobe Premiere Pro preferred, but I am open if you are strong in something else.



Reliable on turnaround. Trends decay. A clip delivered late is a clip wasted.

This is the standard I am after. Please actually watch these.



My own work:







Other creators:

title: Blog Production Specialist
description:
Kova Team manages SEO and content programs for a portfolio of roughly 20 clients, primarily in home services, construction, restoration, roofing, fencing, and remodeling, along with several professional-services accounts.



We are hiring a Blog Production Specialist to support the execution of our blog program. Content plans and keyword research are completed before the work reaches you, and our blog system automates much of the drafting and editing. Your responsibility is to run that system correctly for each client, apply careful human judgment where automation falls short, and ensure every published article is accurate, on-brand, correctly dated, and appropriately illustrated.



This is a production and quality-assurance position rather than a creative writing position. You will work closely with the owner, who remains accountable for the overall program, and will coordinate day to day with our virtual assistants. All work is tracked and communicated through ClickUp.



Scope and onboarding

You will not be handed the full portfolio on day one. New specialists begin with a small number of clients and receive direct support while learning the system, the clients, and our quality standards. As you become confident in the process, additional clients are added until you are supporting the full portfolio.



Once you are up to speed, the owner shifts into a check-in and oversight role while you manage the day-to-day flow of the blog system and coordinate the virtual assistants responsible for images.



Core responsibilities



Article setup and generation

Enter the assigned keyword and keyword title from the client's content plan into the blog system so the tool has the appropriate context and H1, then generate the draft.



Draft review

Review every article before it moves forward, confirming that it:

Reflects the client's documented brand voice

Describes only services the client actually offers

Contains no competitor names

Is accurate and appropriate for the client's market, service area, and customers



Client submission

Submit the reviewed article to the client for approval through the system.



Revisions and verification

When a client requests changes, apply them using our AI editing tool, then verify that each requested change was actually implemented. Verification may involve cross-referencing the revision request against the updated article using AI, reviewing it manually, or both. Any missed or partially applied edit should be identified and corrected before the article moves forward.



Publishing and scheduling accuracy

Publish approved articles to WordPress on their intended dates. Target dates are not always displayed accurately, so you will review the live site, identify which dates have already been filled, and determine where each article belongs. Articles that have passed their scheduled date should be backdated to that date rather than published on the current date, so that each client's blog reflects a consistent and deliberate publishing cadence.



Image coordination

After publishing, our virtual assistants add images. You are responsible for ensuring this is completed promptly and that the selected images genuinely match the content. For example, an article about flat roofing should not be illustrated with pitched roofs. When an image is not a good fit, provide the VA with clear, specific direction in ClickUp on what is needed and confirm the correction is made.



Final review

Complete a final pass on copy, images, formatting, and publish date before the article goes live.



Volume and cadence

Standard clients: 8 articles per month, approximately two per week, spaced roughly every four days

Higher-volume clients: 16 articles per month, approximately four per week, spaced roughly every two days



Consistency is more important than speed. Articles should land on their scheduled dates rather than in clusters.



Tools and communication

All task management and day-to-day communication run through ClickUp, including assignments, status updates, questions to the owner, and direction given to virtual assistants. Work should be documented there rather than handled informally, so that anyone reviewing an account can see where each article stands.



You will also work in our internal blog system, WordPress, and other client CMS platforms as needed.





Trust and system access

This role includes access to internal Kova systems and to the back end of client websites. We are looking for someone who treats that access with the seriousness it deserves: careful with changes, honest about mistakes, protective of client data, and reliable.



We take this seriously and expect the same in return. Candidates should be comfortable with reference checks and with signing a confidentiality agreement.



Qualifications



Required

Excellent written English, with the ability to recognize awkward phrasing, factual inconsistencies, and off-brand tone without being prompted

Strong, sustained attention to detail across repetitive work

Sound judgment and problem-solving instincts: the ability to notice when something is missing, incorrect, or illogical, and to resolve it rather than pass it along

Comfort with structured, administrative, process-driven work

Clear and direct communication in ClickUp, including the ability to give specific, actionable feedback to virtual assistants

Availability with Pacific Time business hours: 9am - 5pm PST

Dependable self-management in a remote role with recurring deadlines

Demonstrated trustworthiness and discretion



Preferred

Experience in copywriting or SEO blog content

Hands-on experience with WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, or comparable CMS platforms

Familiarity with AI writing and editing tools

Experience with ClickUp or a comparable project management platform

Prior agency or multi-client experience



About the nature of the work

We want to set accurate expectations. This role follows the same defined process repeatedly, across many clients, every month. You will not be writing articles from scratch or setting creative direction. The value of the position lies in consistency, accuracy, and the judgment to catch what an automated system would otherwise miss.



Candidates who find satisfaction in well-run, dependable processes tend to do very well in this role.

title: AI Orchestrator & Experimental Systems Builder (n8n, Playwright, MCP)
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a tech-forward Real Estate Company based in Singapore. We are moving away from traditional real estate workflows and building a fully automated, agentic business model. You will be the Technical Lead for our experimental division, working closely with our operations team to bridge the gap between "Ideas on X.com" and "Production-ready systems."



THE MISSION

We don't need a "
 beginner." We need a builder who can live in the experimental gray area. You will be responsible for deploying, maintaining, and scaling high-risk, high-reward automations.



Core Responsibilities:



Agentic Orchestration: Link Claude Desktop/AI Agents to our Notion Second Brain using MCP (Model Context Protocol) or custom REST API bridges for real-time brain dumps and auto-categorization.



Stealth Scraping: Build and maintain Playwright/Puppeteer scrapers for property portals that bypass modern DOM fingerprinting and rate-limiting using residential proxy rotation and stealth plugins.



Deployment & DevOps: Manage deployments on our RackNerd VPS using Docker/Portainer. You should be comfortable reading a raw GitHub README for an experimental AI tool and having a "Hello World" running in an hour.



Modular Support: Architect "Sub-workflow" patterns in n8n that are modular enough for our team to troubleshoot without needing a Senior Dev every time a node fails.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



n8n Mastery: Must understand Idempotent logic, Global Error Triggers, and Async Polling Loops for long-running video render jobs.



IDE Proficiency: You live in Cursor or VS Code. If you don't use AI to 10x your own development speed, you are the wrong fit.



State Management: You treat Notion/Google Sheets as a database with clear Status Flags (e.g., Scraped -> Drafted -> Reviewed -> Posted) to ensure zero double-posts or silent failures.



COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS



Rate: $6-$8 USD / hour



Type: Part-time (approx. 20 hours/week) with long-term growth potential.

Culture: We move fast. You will be expected to "test and learn" with new AI tools daily.



HOW TO APPLY (Automated Test)

Explain: How do you handle asynchronous callback webhooks in n8n for a video API that takes 15 minutes to process?

Describe: Your strategy for bypassing Cloudflare 403 errors when scraping real estate listings.

description:
ADMINISTRATIVE CO-ORDINATOR (REMOTE)



ABOUT US



We are a well-established Caribbean company operating two businesses:



Seasons Fashion – a retail fashion business with a physical store and online operations.



Park View Apartments – a serviced apartment business catering primarily to international medical students and visitors.



We are looking for an intelligent, highly organised and proactive Administrative Co-Ordinator to provide remote administrative support across both businesses.



We are looking for someone who will become a trusted and dependable member of our team over the long term.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is NOT a traditional 40-hour-per-week position.



The position operates on a monthly retainer.



Our workload is seasonal and varies considerably throughout the year. Some weeks and months can be extremely busy, while others may require relatively little work.



We are therefore not looking for someone to sit at a computer for eight hours every day simply to fulfil a fixed number of hours.



What matters to us is availability, responsiveness, reliability and the ability to get things done accurately when required.



We will need you to be responsive and available to work as needed between 8AM and 5PM AST Monday to Friday. Additionally, there is a recurring weekly reporting task (requiring 1 hour or less) that must be completed every week between Saturday 7PM and Sunday 7AM AST.



This arrangement may particularly suit an experienced remote professional who values the stability of a long-term client relationship while retaining some flexibility in how they manage their time.



RESPONSIBILITIES



The Administrative Co-Ordinator will provide support across a wide variety of administrative and operational activities, which may include:



* Customer and tenant communication by
, WhatsApp and live chat

* Responding to
 and Instagram 

* Preparing business correspondence and documents

* Preparing leases and other tenant documentation

* Calendar and appointment management

* Supplier and product research

* General internet research

* Spreadsheet updates and data management

* Preparing monthly electricity billing calculations for tenants

* Preparing data files for import into Xero

* Customer database maintenance

* Preparing reports

* Proofreading correspondence and documents

* Digital file organisation

* Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of SOPs

* Preparing meeting minutes from recorded meetings

* Project and task tracking

* AI-assisted administrative work

* Other general administrative and operational support as required



The nature of the position means that no two weeks will necessarily look the same.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are particularly interested in someone who:



* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is exceptionally organised

* Has excellent attention to detail

* Thinks logically and carefully

* Learns new systems and processes quickly

* Can follow detailed instructions and SOPs accurately

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Uses good judgement

* Takes initiative when appropriate

* Is dependable and responsive

* Is comfortable working with spreadsheets and business data

* Is confident conducting detailed online research

* Is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Communicates professionally with customers, tenants, suppliers and colleagues

* Notices errors, inconsistencies or missing information rather than simply processing what is placed in front of them

* Is interested in developing a genuine long-term working relationship with our businesses



Previous remote administrative experience is preferred.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* A reliable high-speed internet connection

* A modern computer suitable for remote administrative work

* A quiet and professional workspace

* Reliable access to WhatsApp

* The ability to work with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 applications



Experience with any of the following would be advantageous, but is not essential:



* Microsoft Excel

* Microsoft Outlook

* Microsoft Teams

* WordPress

* Shopify

* Xero

* Meta Business Suite

* Canva



We do not expect the successful candidate to already know all of our systems. The ability to learn quickly, follow instructions and work accurately is more important.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



This is a remote monthly-retainer position, not a conventional full-time hourly position.



The successful candidate must be available and responsive during agreed working periods aligned with our business hours in Grenada (Atlantic Standard Time).



Because the workload fluctuates, there will be periods requiring substantial support and other periods when considerably less work is required.



We are looking for someone who understands and is comfortable with this type of working arrangement.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will be agreed as a fixed monthly retainer.



Please state your expected monthly retainer in your application.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit all of the following:



1. Your CV.



2. A cover letter including:



* Your city and country.

* Your internet download and upload speeds.

* Your expected monthly retainer in US dollars.

* A brief explanation of why this particular working arrangement and position interest you.

* Details of any other ongoing employment, freelance clients or regular work commitments you currently have.



We are not looking for the applicant who can send us the longest CV.



We are looking for someone who is capable, dependable, resourceful, responsive and exceptionally good at getting things done.

title: Appointment Setter (Phone + SMS) for US Medical Wellness Clinic
description:
We are 4Ever Young Scottsdale, a busy anti-aging and wellness medical clinic in Arizona, USA. We get new leads every day from ads, our website and our patient database, and we are hiring one full-time Appointment Setter whose only job is turning those leads into booked appointments by phone and text.



SCHEDULE (Arizona time, which is 15 hours behind Manila year-round, no daylight saving changes)

- Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM Arizona (11:30 PM to 9:30 AM Manila), 30-minute lunch

- Saturday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM Arizona (1:00 AM to 5:00 AM Manila)

- Sunday off



HOW YOUR DAY WORKS

Your day runs on a strict priority order. There is no idle time.

1. New leads. The moment one arrives, everything else stops. Call and text within 2 minutes.

2. Follow-ups due today. Every lead gets a scheduled follow-up cadence (day 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 21) until they book or say no.

3. Reactivation lists. Every gap in your day is spent calling and texting our database: past patients, no-shows, abandoned inquiries and old leads. This is most of your dial volume.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call and text every new lead within minutes of it arriving

- Run the follow-up cadence on every open lead

- Work reactivation lists whenever you are not on a new lead or a follow-up

- Book free consultations directly onto our provider calendars

- Log every call and text in GoHighLevel with a disposition

- Hit daily activity targets (dials, texts, conversations) and weekly booking targets



WHAT WE NEED

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. Warm and confident on the phone.

- At least 1 year of appointment setting, inside sales or outbound call center experience for US clients

- Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM (we will train on our setup)

- Comfortable making 80 to 120 outbound calls and texts per day

- Fast, stable internet, backup power, quiet workspace, USB headset

- Willing to sign a HIPAA confidentiality agreement and complete a short HIPAA training

- Experience with US medspas, dental, chiropractic, fitness or healthcare is a big plus



PAY

- $1,450 USD per month base for the 54-hour schedule, paid twice monthly

- Bonus for every consultation that shows up

- 30-day paid trial, then long-term full-time for the right person

- We are looking for someone who stays with us for years



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) introducing yourself and telling us about a time you turned a "maybe" into a booked appointment

2. Your internet speed test screenshot

3. The word "consult" in the first line so we know you read this

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.
