title: Senior Outbound Sales Hunter / Appointment Setter — U.S. Market
description:
THE JOB



We are looking for an elite outbound sales hunter / appointment setter whose primary responsibility is simple:



Create conversations with qualified eCommerce brands and book meetings with decision-makers.



This is NOT customer service.

This is NOT account management.

This is NOT a role where you wait for inbound leads.



You will be expected to hunt every day.



We provide the technology, CRM, prospecting tools, data,
 infrastructure, sales collateral, and executive team. Your job is to turn those resources into qualified meetings.



If you are excellent at researching companies, finding the right executives, cold calling,
ing, following up relentlessly, and getting legitimate prospects onto a calendar, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Build targeted prospect lists of qualified eCommerce brands

Identify the actual decision-makers within those companies

Research prospects before outreach

Cold call aggressively

Run high-volume, targeted outbound

Use LinkedIn and other channels to reach executives

Create and execute multi-touch outbound sequences

Follow up repeatedly instead of giving up after one or two attempts

Reactivate dormant leads and old opportunities

Identify trigger events that create potential sales opportunities

Qualify prospects sufficiently to determine whether a meeting is worthwhile

Book the meeting



Once a legitimate opportunity is identified, you hand it over to the sales team.



You are not responsible for running discovery calls, preparing pricing, designing solutions, or closing contracts.



Your job is to create the opportunity.



YOUR #1 KPI



Qualified Meetings Held.



Not
s sent.

Not LinkedIn connections.

Not names added to a spreadsheet.



We care about qualified prospects who actually attend meetings with our sales leadership.



A qualified meeting means a legitimate eCommerce business with a plausible current or upcoming logistics/fulfillment requirement and the appropriate decision-maker or strong influencer attending.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who has demonstrated that they can hunt and personally create pipeline from nothing.



Experience prospecting or selling into any of the following is especially valuable:



3PL / fulfillment

Logistics

eCommerce

Amazon ecosystem

Supply chain

SaaS serving eCommerce brands

Freight / parcel

Warehousing

eCommerce agencies or services



Direct 3PL experience is highly desirable.



We're much less interested in impressive job titles than in what you personally produced.



Be prepared to tell us:

- How many cold calls you made

- How many meetings you personally booked

- Your meeting conversion rate

- Who you prospected

- How you found prospects

- What tools you used

- What your cold-call opener sounds like



TOOLS

You should be comfortable with modern outbound technology such as:

- HubSpot or comparable CRM

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator

- Apollo / ZoomInfo or similar prospecting databases

-
 sequencing and automation platforms

- AI research and writing tools

- Google Workspace

- Dialers / VoIP systems



You don't need to know every platform, but you should be able to learn new technology quickly.



COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS

Exceptional spoken and written English is mandatory.



You will represent a U.S.-based company and speak directly with founders, CEOs, COOs, and senior supply-chain executives.



You must be confident on the phone, think quickly when someone answers, and communicate professionally with senior U.S. business leaders.



WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

Competitive. Resourceful. Persistent. Curious. Organized. Coachable. Tech-savvy. Unafraid of rejection.



Most importantly: you genuinely enjoy hunting.



You don't need someone to hand you a list of warm leads every morning. You enjoy figuring out which companies to target, who the right person is, how to reach them, and what will get them to respond. When
ing your application, use a subject line with your full name, and make sure the subject line start with Flibbertigibbet.





COMPENSATION

$1,500/month base salary + generous performance-based commission.



You'll earn additional compensation for qualified meetings held, with further upside tied to opportunities and resulting sales.



This is a production-driven role designed to meaningfully reward people who perform.



Strong performers can earn $2,500–$3,500/month, with $4,000+ months possible for exceptional performers.



If you consistently create legitimate sales opportunities, your earning potential should reflect it.





HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, you must
 your application to 
 submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.



REQUIRED: Include a link to a 60–90 second voice or video introduction using Vocaroo or Google Drive.



In your recording, briefly:

Introduce yourself

Describe your outbound sales experience

Tell us why you're a strong fit for a high-performance hunting role



To strengthen your application, we also encourage you to include:

- The types of companies you've previously prospected

- Your historical outbound activity and meeting-booking numbers

 you personally wrote that generated meetings

title: US GovCon Proposal Writer & Bid Compliance Expert (RFPs / SAM.gov / Federal Contracting)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a fast-growing US-based company active in US Government Contracting (GovCon) and Public Sector Procurement. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and highly skilled Proposal Writer & Bid Compliance Expert to lead our end-to-end RFP/RFQ proposal responses.

In US Federal & Public Sector Procurement, submission accuracy and strict compliance are non-negotiable—a single missing clause or formatting error means immediate disqualification. We need a seasoned proposal writer who understands how to dissect SOWs, build comprehensive compliance matrices, and craft compelling, high-scoring technical responses.

If you have a proven track record of writing winning bids for US federal, state, or local agencies, we want to hear from you!

???? KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-to-End Proposal Creation: Draft, structure, and finalize compliant responses for RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, and ITBs.

Compliance Matrix & SOW Analysis: Thoroughly review solicitation documents and Statement of Work (SOW) requirements to build accurate compliance matrices.

Technical Writing: Write high-scoring narrative sections, including Technical Execution Plans, Quality Control Protocols, Management Plans, Past Performance summaries, and Capability Statements.

FAR/DFARS Alignment: Ensure all bid responses comply strictly with federal acquisition regulations and client guidelines.

Review & Final Polish: Collaborate with leadership to review draft proposals, eliminate errors, ensure 100% compliance, and submit well ahead of deadlines.

???? WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (REQUIREMENTS)

Proven US GovCon Experience: At least 2+ years of direct experience writing and managing US government proposals (Federal, State, or Local).

Deep Portal & Process Knowledge: Familiarity with SAM.gov, NAICS/PSC codes, FAR/DFARS regulations, and standard RFP/RFQ structures.

Exceptional Written English: Advanced/Native-level written English (C1/C2) with strong persuasive and technical writing skills.

No Unedited AI: Ability to write clear, humanized, agency-specific content (we strictly test for and reject unedited ChatGPT output).

Extreme Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for compliance errors, missing attachments, or missed deadlines.

❌ THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

You are a beginner looking for on-the-job training in GovCon writing.

You rely on unedited ChatGPT or generic template dumps.

You manage multiple full-time client commitments and cannot deliver focused, reliable work.

You require step-by-step micromanagement to meet strict submission deadlines.

???? WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Pay: $600 – $900+/month based on verified experience and past bid win volume.

Long-Term Stability: Stable, long-term positioning with performance-based raises as bid wins increase.

Growth Opportunity: Potential to lead our proposal team as our GovCon footprint expands.

Supportive Environment: Clear directives, direct access to leadership, and streamline processes.

???? MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To prove your attention to detail and relevant experience, you MUST answer the following 4 screening questions in your initial application message:

TRACK RECORD: What is the total dollar value or win volume of US Government contracts you have directly written winning proposals for? Please share specific agency types or project scopes if possible.

COMPLIANCE MATRIX SCENARIO: Describe your step-by-step process for reviewing a 50+ page RFP SOW and turning it into a complete, bulletproof Compliance Matrix.

TECH STACK & TOOLS: List all procurement portals, bid tools, and documentation software you are fluent with (e.g., SAM.gov, GovWin, MS Word/Excel, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace).

SALARY & AVAILABILITY: What is your target monthly salary (in USD) and weekly hours availability (Full-Time or Part-Time)?

⚠️ ATTENTION TO DETAIL TEST:

Format your application message subject line EXACTLY as follows:

GOVCON PROPOSAL WRITER - [Your Full Name]

(Example: GOVCON PROPOSAL WRITER - Juan Dela Cruz)

Applications missing answers to the screening questions or using automated boilerplate messages will be automatically rejected.

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups: mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing U.S. company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines.



Role details

What you'll own

, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

You're a strong fit if you

 newsletters, listing promotions, client updates, and basic social media scheduling.

title: High-Ticket Client Success Manager – Earn up to $3,000+ USD/month
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: GCLID tracking setup for my ads
description:
# Google Ads Conversion Tracking Specialist — GCLID / ServiceM8 / n8n



**Type:** Project-based (with potential ongoing retainer for maintenance)

**Location:** Remote, Philippines preferred

**Client:** Laserline Tiling Ltd — tiling & waterproofing contractor, Christchurch, New Zealand



## The Problem We Need Solved



Right now, Google Ads counts a "conversion" the moment someone submits a form on our website. But a form submission isn't a sale — some of those leads turn into real, paid tiling jobs, and some go nowhere. Google Ads currently can't tell the difference, which means our ad spend is being optimized toward *form fills*, not *real customers*.



We need someone to build (and verify end-to-end) a pipeline that:

1. Captures the Google Click ID (GCLID) when someone clicks our ad and lands on our site

2. Passes that GCLID through to the job record in **ServiceM8** (our job management system)

3. Tracks that job through to a real outcome (quoted, won, lost)

4. Automatically reports **won jobs** back to Google Ads as offline conversions — so Google starts optimizing toward actual paying customers, not just enquiries



Our automation layer is **n8n**, already linked to ServiceM8. There is a partially-built pipeline using 
 that may be scrapped or migrated — you'll assess and recommend.



## Scope of Work



1. **Audit the website form** — confirm the hidden GCLID field correctly captures the parameter from the ad click and isn't dropped on submission (flagged as a known risk with our current CMS setup).

2. **Verify GCLID reaches ServiceM8** — confirm it's correctly attached to the job/quote record via API or webhook.

3. **Build the n8n workflow** that:

   - Monitors job status changes in ServiceM8 (Quote Sent → Won / Lost / Completed)

   - Matches the outcome to the stored GCLID

   - Formats and uploads the conversion (GCLID, conversion action, value, date) to Google Ads via the **Offline Conversion Import** API on an appropriate schedule

4. **Test end-to-end** with real test leads to confirm conversions appear correctly in Google Ads, attributed to the right keyword and campaign.

5. **Document the finished workflow** — a plain-English walkthrough plus a simple diagram, so our team can troubleshoot without you.

6. **Recommend and implement** whether to repair the existing 
 piece or rebuild fully in n8n, given ServiceM8 is already integrated there.



## Must-Have Skills



- Demonstrated experience with the **Google Ads API / Offline Conversion Import (OCI)** — please share a specific example or portfolio piece

- Strong **n8n** workflow-building experience

- Comfortable reading/writing to the **ServiceM8 API** or webhooks

- Working knowledge of **Google Tag Manager / JavaScript** for GCLID capture on web forms

- Clear written English and async communication — you'll be working with a NZ-based owner (Christchurch, GMT+12) with limited overlap hours



## Nice to Have



- Experience with Google Ads Enhanced Conversions

- Prior work with home service / trade businesses

- Familiarity with ClickUp for documentation handoff

- Experience with 
 (to help assess/migrate the existing partial build)



## Deliverables



- A verified, working GCLID → ServiceM8 → n8n → Google Ads pipeline, tested with real data

- Written documentation covering how it works and how to troubleshoot common failures

- A short screen-recorded walkthrough (Loom or similar) of the finished workflow



## How to Apply



Please include:

1. A specific example of an offline conversion import or similar Google Ads API integration you've built (screenshot, Loom, or GitHub link)

2. A short Loom walkthrough of an n8n workflow you've built previously

3. Your estimate of hours/timeline to complete this scope

4. Your hourly or fixed-project rate



---

*Note: rate/budget range and expected hours are intentionally left open above — fill in before posting based on what you're willing to pay.*

title: Part-Time Opportunities & Outreach Assistant
description:
Part-Time Virtual Assistant for Outreach, Opportunities, Grants, and Tracking



Location: Remote

Hours: Part-time, approximately 10–15 hours per week to start

Type: Contract / Freelance



About Me



I’m a Los Angeles–based artist, creator, and creative entrepreneur working at the intersection of art, content, media, and culture. My work spans creative projects, brand partnerships, content creation, applications, funding opportunities, and long-term career-building across multiple lanes.



I move quickly, generate a high volume of ideas, and am focused on growing both the creative and business side of what I do. I’m looking for someone who can help support that growth by keeping outreach moving, finding strong opportunities, submitting applications, researching grants, and, most importantly, tracking everything in a clean and organized way.



About the Role



I’m looking for a sharp, proactive, highly organized part-time virtual assistant to help me generate and manage opportunities across brand outreach, creative and contract applications, auditions, artist grants, fellowships, residencies, and other aligned opportunities.



This is not a passive admin role. I am specifically looking for someone who can help create momentum.



A major part of this role is tracking. I need someone who is excellent at keeping score so we can clearly see how many opportunities are being pursued, what stage they’re in, what needs follow-up, and what is actually working. If you are someone who naturally likes creating order out of chaos, this role may be a strong fit.



Key Responsibilities

Outreach and Lead Generation



Send initial outreach to brands, collaborators, agencies, media contacts, and other aligned opportunities using my existing system



Personalize outreach templates when needed



Research and identify new contacts, opportunities, and potential partnership leads



Support outreach efforts across brand partnerships, creator opportunities, media, and other relevant channels



Opportunity Research



Proactively seek new opportunities that align with my work and goals



Research brand partnerships, creative contracts, auditions, creator programs, fellowships, residencies, grants, and open calls



Filter for strong-fit opportunities rather than sending or submitting randomly



Surface the most relevant opportunities in an organized and efficient way



Applications and Submissions



Fill out and submit applications using my saved materials, links, and information



Help with applications for contracts, jobs, creative opportunities, auditions, fellowships, grants, and other opportunities



Keep reusable materials organized, including bios, resumes, portfolio links, media kits, headshots, artist statements, and related assets



Draft first-pass responses when needed for review



Grant Research and Grant Support



Research artist grants, funding opportunities, fellowships, residencies, and public/open calls



Track deadlines, eligibility requirements, and submission materials



Help identify which grants are worth pursuing



Assist with preparing and submitting straightforward grant applications



Organize recurring grant opportunities and seasonal funding deadlines



Tracking and Pipeline Management



Maintain clear, accurate trackers for outreach, applications, grants, deadlines, submissions, responses, follow-ups, and outcomes



Keep records organized so we know what has been sent, what is pending, what needs attention, and what is moving



Help monitor volume, response rates, warm leads, and active opportunities



Create and maintain a clear scoreboard so we can measure progress and make better decisions



Follow-Up and Organization



Follow up on cold and warm leads so opportunities do not fall through the cracks



Keep notes on where conversations stand and what the next step is



Organize information so active leads can be handed off smoothly when needed



Help bring structure, consistency, and follow-through to a fast-moving workflow



Ideal Candidate



You are someone who is:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented



Strong at tracking multiple moving parts without letting things slip



A solid writer and communicator



Good at online research and information gathering



Comfortable with repetitive tasks, but smart enough to use judgment



Proactive and able to take initiative without waiting for constant instructions



Resourceful, reliable, and discreet



Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving creative environment



Bonus If You Have Experience With



Brand outreach



Grant applications or artist funding research



Creator support



Casting or audition submissions



Research-heavy assistant work



Building or maintaining trackers, CRMs, spreadsheets, or Notion systems



Working with artists, creators, entrepreneurs, or media professionals



What I’m Looking For Personality-Wise



I move fast, work across several lanes at once, and have a high volume of ideas and goals in motion. The right person for this role is someone who can bring structure to that motion.



You do not need to be overly formal, but you do need to be sharp, proactive, dependable, and good at follow-through. I’m looking for someone who can help build momentum, not just someone who waits to be told what to do.



Success in This Role Looks Like



More outreach being sent consistently



More strong-fit opportunities being surfaced



More applications and grants being submitted on time



Better tracking across everything in motion



Fewer missed follow-ups



Clear visibility into pipeline, progress, and outcomes



Less admin and opportunity-management work on my plate overall



Compensation



Please include your hourly rate when applying.



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about who you are



Relevant experience



Any examples of outreach, assistant work, opportunity research, grant support, application work, or tracking systems you’ve managed



Your hourly rate



Your weekly availability



Optional but helpful: a brief note on why you think you’d be a strong fit for this role



If you are someone who enjoys finding opportunities, keeping things organized, and helping creative people grow, I’d love to hear from you.

title: After Effects Motion Designer-— Short-Form Social Content
description:
After Effects Motion Designer — Short-Form Social Content

Paid Per Project to start and could evolve to Paid Monthly Per Client 



*IMPORTANT:* We understand that CapCut is an accessible and increasingly popular tool for short-form content. However, we are specifically looking for an After Effects-first motion designer. If CapCut is your primary program for creating motion graphics, this position probably isn't the right fit.



Templates, plugins, presets, and other tools can absolutely be part of your workflow, but we're looking for someone capable of designing and animating intentionally rather than relying primarily on pre-built templates.



We are looking for a skilled Motion Designer who specializes in Adobe After Effects to work with us on an ongoing freelance basis, primarily creating motion graphics, typography, captions, and visual assets for short-form social content.



This is not a video editing position. 



Our editors handle the core edit. Your role is to take detailed creative briefs and provided assets and bring specific moments of the video to life through motion design.



Depending on the project, your work may include:



Animated typography

Captions and subtitles

Titles and text treatments

Image and photo animations

Motion graphics

Masks and compositing

Custom assets designed to support the edit



Some videos may require just caption design.



Others may combine captions, typography, imagery, graphics, and more involved animation.



We will typically provide the creative brief, copy/captions, images, brand assets, backgrounds, fonts, and overall visual direction.



Your responsibility is to execute that direction at a high level while also bringing your own design judgment to the work.



Our work generally leans premium, modern, editorial, minimal, and intentional.



We're looking for someone who understands that good motion design isn't about making everything move.



It's about knowing what should move, how it should move, and when restraint creates a stronger result.



You should have a strong understanding of:



Typography and hierarchy

Composition

Spacing

Scale

Visual rhythm

Animation timing

Pacing

Brand consistency

Clean, intentional transitions



Motion / Animation References



These examples aren't meant to be replicated exactly, but they provide a general reference for the level of motion we're looking for:



[Instagram reference]





[Instagram reference]





Caption + Title Inspiration



[Instagram reference]





Each client and project will have its own visual system and creative brief.



Requirements



Adobe After Effects must be your primary motion-design tool.



We're looking for someone who:



Is highly proficient in Adobe After Effects

Has experience designing specifically for short-form / 9:16 content

Has a strong understanding of typography and typographic hierarchy

Has excellent visual composition and design instincts

Understands premium, modern, editorial, and minimalist visual design

Can follow detailed creative briefs accurately

Can work within established brand guidelines

Is comfortable receiving and implementing feedback

Can take an existing concept and creatively improve it **without abandoning the original direction**

Understands how motion graphics interact with video editing

Can organize and deliver clean project/source files

Communicates clearly and proactively

Has strong time-management skills

Can consistently meet agreed-upon deadlines



Life happens, and we understand that occasionally something unexpected can affect a deadline. What matters to us is that delays are RARE and communicated proactively rather than after a deadline has already been missed.



Projects will generally look something like:



Creative brief → Assets provided → Motion design → Review/revisions → Final asset delivery



Depending on the project, final delivery may include rendered assets for our editor as well as organized After Effects project files.



For animations requiring transparency, you should be comfortable delivering appropriate formats such as ProRes 4444 with alpha.



Projects are paid per project, with pricing agreed upon before work begins.



For the right person, our goal is to build an ongoing working relationship and consistently send projects rather than hire for a single project.



Application



Please include:



1. Your portfolio or 3–5 examples of work most relevant to this position

2. Your general availability and turn around times 



Please do not send only a general video-editing reel. We specifically want to see your ability as a motion designer.



Test Project



Finalists may be asked to complete a small test project based on one of our creative briefs.



The purpose of the test is to evaluate:



Your ability to follow a creative brief

Design judgment

Typography

Motion

Attention to detail

Communication

Ability to deliver within an agreed timeline



The test should be submitted **watermarked** and will not be used unless paid for. 



Please only apply if you're confident that your experience and portfolio align with the requirements above.



We're looking for someone who can take strong creative direction, execute it precisely, and then use their own creative judgment to make the final result even better.

title: HR & COMPLIANCE OFFICER
description:
**HR & COMPLIANCE OFFICER**

Full-Time | Remote — Open Worldwide | Reports to: Executive Leadership



**About the Role**



We're hiring an HR & Compliance Officer to lead people operations and regulatory compliance for a growing professional services company with a nationwide U.S. client base and a distributed, global team. You'll be the go-to owner for onboarding, personnel administration, credential and background-check tracking, and business/regulatory filings — keeping the organization audit-ready at all times. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who is equal parts organized, detail-obsessed, and comfortable being the last line of defense on compliance.



**What You'll Do**



*HR Administration*

- Manage the full employee and contractor lifecycle — offer letters, onboarding paperwork, tax and identity documentation, and personnel recordkeeping.

- Build and maintain onboarding materials, employee handbooks, and role-specific training documentation.

- Run a structured performance and milestone review cycle (plan → execute → check-in → follow-up) for staff across departments.

- Support recruitment logistics — job postings, interview scheduling, reference checks — for internal hires.

- Serve as the first point of contact for employee relations questions, escalating sensitive matters appropriately.



*Compliance & Credentialing*

- Track and verify required certifications, licenses, and state-specific credentials for a distributed U.S. workforce operating across multiple states.

- Own background-check processes end to end, ensuring documentation satisfies client, contract, and regulatory requirements.

- Maintain business certifications and any federal/state registrations, tracking renewal deadlines and filing requirements before they lapse.

- Monitor multi-state registration and licensing status, and lead documentation efforts when expanding into new states.

- Keep company policies, compensation guidelines, and compliance handbooks current with applicable law, and apply standard operating procedures (SOPs) consistently across all HR and compliance processes.

- Respond to compliance and audit requests from clients, partners, and contracting agencies.

- Maintain confidential personnel and compliance files in line with data privacy and recordkeeping standards.



**Who You Are**

- Bachelor's degree required (any field).

- 2+ years of experience in HR administration, compliance, or credentialing — staffing, healthcare, legal services, or another regulated/contract-driven industry preferred.

- C2 (proficient/mastery) level English, across speaking, reading, and listening — this role requires clear, precise communication with U.S.-based clients and staff.

- Before applying, please test your English level using the free EF SET English Test (
) and include your score/certificate with your application.

- Resume demonstrating proven, relevant experience, plus professional references who can confirm your work.

- Reliable home office setup: a computer, one to two additional monitors, a quiet working environment, and a stable, dependable internet connection.

- Trustworthy and self-directed — able to work independently and reliably with minimal supervision, as well as collaboratively when needed.

- Energetic and engaged, bringing genuine knowledge and judgment to the business rather than just following instructions.

- Disciplined about applying SOPs and documented processes consistently, without cutting corners.

- Working knowledge of core employment documentation (e.g., I-9, W-9/1099, W-2 equivalents) and background-check processes.

- Strong written communication — able to turn policy and legal requirements into clear, usable staff-facing documentation.



**Nice to Have**

- Experience with minority/women-owned business certifications (MWBE/WBE/MBE) or public-sector and federal contract compliance.

- SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP, PHR/SPHR, or equivalent HR certification.

- Experience supporting a staffing, interpreting, translation, or other credential-heavy service industry.



**Key Performance Indicators**



| KPI | Target | Frequency |

|---|---|---|

| Credential / background-check compliance rate | 100% | Monthly |

| Certifications & registrations filed on time (business, state, federal) | 100% | Ongoing / per deadline |

| New-hire onboarding completed within policy timeline | ≥ 95% | Monthly |

| Personnel & compliance file audit accuracy | 100% audit-ready | Quarterly |

| Multi-state registration coverage maintained / expanded | Zero lapses | Quarterly |

| Policy & handbook currency | Reviewed 2x/year minimum | Semi-annual |

| Performance review cycle completion | ≥ 95% | Quarterly |

| Response time to compliance/audit requests | ≤ 3 business days | Ongoing |

| SOP adherence across HR/compliance processes | 100% | Ongoing |

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER / MULTILINGUAL INTERPRETER
description:
About the Role

We're hiring an Operations Manager / Multilingual Interpreter to oversee day-to-day service delivery for a growing language services company serving clients across the U.S. with a distributed, global team. You'll own the operational engine of the business — assignment fulfillment, team coordination, quality standards, and process discipline — while also being available to personally interpret sessions in your own language pair(s) when needed. This is a leadership role for someone who thrives on structure, solves problems before they escalate, and can manage people and process while still being a hands-on linguist.

What You'll Do

Operations Leadership

• Oversee daily operations across scheduling, assignment fulfillment, and service delivery, ensuring coverage targets are consistently met.

• Lead and support Team Coordinators and Interpreter Managers, setting priorities and resolving escalations.

• Own and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) across departments, ensuring consistent execution at every level.

• Apply a structured assignment-confirmation protocol (e.g., a 72-hour advance-confirmation window) to minimize last-minute gaps.

• Run a structured issue-response protocol for in-session problems, cancellations, and client escalations, ensuring timely resolution.

• Apply a plan → do → check → succeed review cycle to monitor team and process performance on a recurring basis.

Quality & Client Success

• Monitor service quality using standardized quality-monitoring reports, and drive corrective action where standards slip.

• Partner with Client Success to support key accounts, addressing operational needs proactively.

• Track team and process performance against KPIs, reporting trends and risks to leadership.

• Maintain accurate operational records — staffing rosters, certifications, and assignment history — for audit readiness.

• Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and lead process improvements to resolve them.

Interpreting

• Provide accurate, professional interpretation (consecutive and/or simultaneous) in your language pair(s) when called on to support coverage gaps or key assignments.

• Model the quality and professionalism standards you expect your team to uphold, following industry code of ethics and confidentiality standards.

title: US Client Success Specialist – $2,000/month Base + Uncapped Commissions (USD)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
FULL-TIME COLD CALLER & SMS CAMPAIGN ASSISTANT

40 HOURS PER WEEK | $4.00 PER HOUR



A private real estate investment firm is hiring a full-time cold caller to join its growing vacant-land acquisition team. This person will primarily make outbound calls and will also assist with SMS campaigns and seller follow-up.



This is a long-term position for someone who is ambitious, hardworking, dependable, positive, happy, and naturally energetic.



Sales experience would be helpful, but it is not required. If you are the kind of person everyone wants to talk to—someone who is naturally friendly, engaging, confident, and able to connect easily with others—this position may be perfect for you!



This is not a passive assistant position. You must be comfortable making outbound calls, speaking confidently with property owners, asking qualifying questions, handling objections, working with SMS campaigns, and following up consistently.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Make outbound calls to vacant-land owners using BatchDialer

• Follow our provided calling scripts and rebuttals

• Build rapport and have natural, professional conversations

• Determine whether property owners are interested in selling

• Gather accurate property and seller information

• Complete our seller webform thoroughly and correctly

• Schedule callbacks and consistently follow up with interested sellers

• Assist with outbound SMS campaigns using approved messages and procedures

• Review and organize incoming SMS responses

• Respond to seller messages using approved scripts

• Properly identify interested sellers, follow-up opportunities, wrong numbers, and opt-out requests

• Escalate qualified seller leads promptly

• Keep organized notes on every call, text conversation, and follow-up

• Submit a daily end-of-day report with calls, texts, leads, callbacks, and results

• Communicate regularly with management and follow instructions carefully



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



• Excellent spoken and written English

• Cold-calling, outbound sales, customer-service, or SMS campaign experience is preferred but not required

• A confident, friendly, upbeat, and energetic phone presence

• Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and builds rapport easily

• Strong written communication skills for seller text conversations

• Strong work ethic and willingness to make a high volume of calls

• Ambitious and motivated by goals and measurable results

• Comfortable hearing “no” and continuing with the same positive attitude

• Reliable, punctual, organized, and coachable

• Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural

• Careful attention to detail when entering seller information

• Stable internet connection, reliable computer, quality headset, and quiet workspace

• Available to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Vacant-land or real-estate experience is helpful but not required. We will provide training on our process, scripts, systems, SMS procedures, and seller-qualification requirements. However, you must already be comfortable communicating with people by both phone and text.



COMPENSATION:



• $4.00 USD per hour

• 40 hours per week

• $160.00 USD per week

• Long-term opportunity for the right person



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining any cold-calling, sales, customer-service, or SMS campaign experience

2. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why people enjoy talking to you

3. Your internet speed-test results

4. Details about your computer, headset, and backup internet or power

5. Confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

6. Confirmation that you are available for the group interview on Saturday, September 5, at 6:00 PM Eastern Time

7. Your answer to this question: How do you remain positive and energetic after several people have rejected your offer or ended the call?



To confirm that you carefully read the entire posting, begin your application with:



“I AM YOUR NEXT ENERGETIC COLD CALLER.”



INTERVIEW PROCESS:



Qualified applicants will be shortlisted for a group interview on Saturday, September 5, at 6:00 PM Eastern Time.



Only 8–10 applicants will be selected for the group interview. Please apply only if you are available at that exact time and are genuinely interested in a full-time, long-term position.



We are looking for someone who wants to work hard, grow with us, and become a long-term part of our team’s growth and success.

 and SMS

Manage simple recurring

Excellent written English — you will be writing customer-facing copy

Experience running

Shopify

Copywriting portfolio

Answer all nine questions below in your reply. Applications that skip questions will not be reviewed.

Tell me about an

title: Property Management Customer Service Representative (Remote)
description:
Property Management Customer Service Representative (Remote)



Self-Storage & Warehouse Properties | Full-Time | Long-Term



We own and operate three self-storage and warehouse properties in Florida and are looking for a full-time Property Management Customer Service Representative to become a key part of our team.



This isn't a typical customer service role.



Every phone call or
 leads to work that needs to be completed—from preparing leases and setting up payments to coordinating repairs and following up on overdue accounts. You'll be responsible for keeping every customer request and operational task moving until it's fully resolved.



If you're someone who takes ownership, follows through, and enjoys seeing things to completion, we'd love to hear from you.



Schedule



Full-time (40 hours per week)

Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM or 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time

Remote



What You'll Do



You'll manage customer interactions from first inquiry through move-in and ongoing account support.



Your responsibilities include:



Answer phone calls and
s from prospective and existing customers

Help customers choose the right storage unit or warehouse space for their needs

Prepare leases and guide customers through the rental process

Set up payment arrangements and maintain accurate customer accounts

Follow up professionally on overdue balances

Coordinate local contractors for maintenance and repairs

Confirm repair work has been completed and documented

Prepare and send lien notices according to company procedures and deadlines

Track every open task through completion using our task management system

Maintain accurate records and ensure nothing falls through the cracks



What We're Looking For



Required Experience



We're looking for someone with previous experience in one or more of the following:



Property management

Self-storage operations

Leasing offices

Rental administration

HOA administration

 Residential or commercial property coordination



You should have experience working with leases, tenant payments, and customer accounts—not just answering customer service calls.



The Right Person for This Role



You'll be successful if you:



Naturally follow through until every task is complete

Stay organized while managing multiple ongoing priorities

Pay close attention to details, deadlines, and documentation

Are comfortable speaking with US customers over the phone

Can confidently handle conversations about overdue payments while remaining professional and respectful

Communicate clearly in both spoken and written English

Enjoy solving problems rather than passing them to someone else



Technical Requirements



You must have:



Reliable computer

Quality USB noise-cancelling headset

Hardwired Ethernet connection (Wi-Fi alone is not sufficient)

Backup internet connection

Quiet, professional workspace with minimal background noise



Work Environment



We provide structured training and detailed written procedures for nearly every process. You'll be supported with documented systems, but you'll also be trusted to take ownership of your work and see every task through to completion.



What We Offer



Competitive hourly pay based on experience

Paid training

Stable, long-term employment

A small, established company with clear processes and expectations

Well-documented SOPs and ongoing support



Please Note



This is a full-time position requiring availability during US Eastern business hours.

We use time-tracking software and are transparent about it from the beginning. We measure productivity and accountability, not micromanagement.

We are seeking someone committed to this role as their primary full-time position.



How to Apply



Please include:



Your resume

 A short voice recording introducing yourself

Briefly describe a time you had to follow up repeatedly with others to get an important task completed

Tell us which property management, leasing, or rental systems you've used and what your responsibilities were in those systems



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates professionally, and finishes what they start. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About School Psych AI

School Psych AI is a bootstrapped EdTech company serving school psychologists, special educators, and related service providers across the country. We run on Stripe for subscription revenue, Gusto for payroll, QuickBooks Online for accounting, and we sell to school districts on purchase orders with real procurement timelines. 



About the Role

We need a bookkeeper who will get our books accurate and keep them that way. Right now our QuickBooks does not tie to our bank. Balances are off, credit card accounts are misstated, deposits are uncategorized, and our P&L cannot be trusted for decision-making or for a lender. Your first job is cleanup. Your ongoing job is making sure it never drifts again.

This is not a role where you wait for instructions. We are looking for someone who spots the discrepancy before we do and tells us plainly what they found.



What You'll Do

Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts monthly, and clean up historical periods that were never properly reconciled

Categorize transactions correctly and consistently, including Stripe deposits, payouts, and fees

Maintain accurate accounts receivable for district contracts, invoices sent, and payments collected

Track and record our line of credit activity, including draws, weekly repayments, fees, and interest

Record payroll from Gusto correctly, including taxes, benefits, and contractor payments

Produce a monthly close package: profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow, delivered on a set schedule

Flag discrepancies, unusual charges, and anything that does not reconcile, without waiting to be asked

Prepare clean, lender-ready financials when we need them

Coordinate with our CPA at tax time



Who We're Looking For

You are meticulous. Numbers either tie or they do not, and you do not move on until they do.

You communicate clearly in plain language. We need someone who can tell a non-accountant founder what a number means and why it changed, without jargon and without burying the point.



You raise issues early. If cash is trending in a direction we should know about, or something looks miscategorized, you say so before it becomes a problem.



You work independently. This is remote, part-time, and largely self-directed. You will own the close calendar and hold yourself to it.

title: Executive / Personal Assistant to Busy Entrepreneur (Long-Term, High Trust Role)
description:
A busy entrepreneur is looking for a highly capable, reliable Executive/Personal Assistant to support both business operations and personal life. This is a varied, high-responsibility role for someone who is sharp, proactive, and trustworthy — not a repetitive, low-responsibility VA position. Must be available 10AM–6PM PST.



About the Role

I'm a busy entrepreneur who owns and operates a successful luxury service business, actively searches for additional businesses to acquire, and has a background in real estate investing and management. I work on multiple entrepreneurial projects at once, communicate regularly with business partners, investors, vendors, and other professionals, and also have a full personal life — family, appointments, medical obligations, travel, and other commitments.

I'm looking for a true right-hand Executive/Personal Assistant: someone who can manage both my business and personal world, keep me organized and on schedule, and represent me professionally with the people I work with. This is a combination EA + PA role, and the work will vary significantly day to day — this is not a job with the same few repetitive tasks every day.



What You'll Do

- Manage personal and business calendars; schedule appointments, meetings, calls, reminders, and Zoom meetings

- Coordinate and occasionally communicate directly with business partners and investors

- Build and maintain investor, networking, acquisition, and contact databases

- Support research on potential business acquisitions and other projects

- Conduct research, data collection, and maintain spreadsheets as directed

- Track projects, deadlines, follow-ups, and priorities, and keep me accountable

- Manage inboxes, send
s/texts, and handle follow-ups

- Make outbound phone calls when necessary

- Book flights, hotels, transportation, and handle travel logistics and reservations

- Assist with a wide range of business and personal projects — you'll often need to take incomplete instructions, use good judgment, and figure out how to move things forward independently.



Who You'll Be Working With

You'll interact directly with business partners, investors, vendors, and other professional contacts on my behalf, so professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential. You'll also be trusted with important business and personal information, so confidentiality matters.



Requirements

- Strong previous Executive Assistant experience (required); Personal Assistant experience is a major plus

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong organization and attention to detail

- High intelligence, judgment, and problem-solving ability

- Initiative and resourcefulness — comfortable working independently without constant supervision

- Confident and professional on the phone; comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with investors and business professionals

- Strong computer, spreadsheet, calendar,
, and internet research skills

- Stable employment history

- Professionalism, maturity, discretion, and trustworthiness

- Genuine interest in a long-term, stable position



Availability

Must be available and responsive 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday. Reliability and responsiveness are critical to this role — if I call and you can't answer, I expect a prompt callback or message. This is not a fit for anyone who tends to go quiet, miss meetings, respond slowly, or need frequent follow-up to get things done.



Why This Role

This is intended to become a long-term, trusted working relationship. For the right person, this grows into a genuine right-hand role with real ownership and responsibility — not just task execution.



How to Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Please answer the screening questions thoughtfully — generic or low-effort applications will not be considered. Include your resume, a brief note on your EA/PA experience, and if possible, a portfolio or sample of your work (e.g. a sample inbox/email management workflow, a calendar/scheduling system you've used, a spreadsheet or tracker you've built, or a brief write-up of your process for managing someone's schedule and communications). Screening Questions

- This role requires availability from 10 AM–6 PM PST. Can you confirm you can consistently work these hours?

- Describe a time you had to complete a task with incomplete or unclear instructions. How did you handle it?

title: Executive Assistant to Operations Manager — Luxury Short-Term Rental Company (Remote, Full-Time)

Benefits: Health insurance (Maxicare Silver Plan) provided after 6 months of employment. Up to 5 days of paid time off per year.

Type: Long-term, with room to grow as the company scales





About Us



Helios Vacation Rentals is a boutique, white-glove short-term rental property management company based in the Greater Palm Springs / Coachella Valley area (Palm Springs, La Quinta, Indio). We manage a portfolio of luxury vacation homes for discerning owners and guests, backed by an in-house local team and a reputation built on Superhost status, a 4.93 rating, and 2,000+ five-star reviews.



We're growing quickly, and our Operations Manager, Marcela, needs a true right hand — someone who can become an extension of her, not just a task-taker. We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant who wants to own this role and grow with us long-term.



This is a long-term opportunity, not a seasonal or short-term gig. All of our current virtual tea
mbers have been with Helios for years, and we're looking for someone who wants to build a career with us — not just fill a temporary role. If you're looking for stability and a company that invests in its people over the long haul, this is the right place.



About the Role



This is first and foremost an Executive Assistant role. You will work directly with the Operations Manager as her second set of eyes and ears — anticipating what she needs, catching things before they become problems, and handling recurring work so she can focus on higher-level priorities.



The right person for this role does not need to ask "how do I do this?" for every task. We're looking for someone who thinks proactively, uses good judgment, figures things out, and comes to Marcela with solutions rather than just questions. Property management or short-term rental experience is a nice-to-have, but the core of this role is being an outstanding, resourceful Executive Assistant.



Key Responsibilities



Inbox & Communication Management:

Triage and manage the Operations Manager's
 inbox — flag urgent items, draft responses, archive noise

Monitor and schedule guest and owner escalations as needed

Coordinate communication with our in-house team, cleaners, vendors, and contractors





Calendar & Scheduling:

Manage and protect the Operations Manager's calendar

Schedule vendor appointments, inspections, and team check-ins

Coordinate house manager and cleaning schedules around guest turnovers





Operations Support:

Track guest reservations, check-in/check-out schedules, and property turnover timelines using Hostaway

Help maintain inspection records and flag any issues that need follow-up

Maintain organized digital filing systems (contracts, owner agreements, vendor invoices, inspection reports) using Google Drive and Breezeway





Task & Project Coordination:

Track deadlines, follow up on open action items, and keep projects moving without being chased

Help build out and improve our SOPs using Notion

Support onboarding of new homes into our portfolio (setup checklists, documentation, systems entry, listing setup)

Track STR (short-term rental) permit renewal deadlines and manage the related paperwork (this is a deadline-and-document-tracking task — no licensing knowledge required)





Reporting & Documentation:

Track and maintain employee timesheets

Build and maintain Excel spreadsheets for reporting and tracking

Data entry and record-keeping across our property management systems





Guest & Owner Support:

Monitor guest escalations and help ensure timely follow-up and resolution

Support homeowner communication (updates, reporting, general correspondence)

Append and enrich homeowner/property owner lead lists (research and verify contact details) and help maintain leads in our CRM (GoHighLevel)





General Support:

Research tasks (vendors, local service providers, etc.) as needed

Ad hoc support for Marcela and the founder as priorities shift





Working with AI:

Use AI tools, specifically Claude, as part of your daily workflow — for drafting communications, research, organizing information, and streamlining recurring tasks







Who You Are:



2+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or vacation rental property management (general VA experience alone is not enough — we need someone who has genuinely operated as a right hand to an executive or manager before or who has extensive experience with short term rentals)

A proactive, ownership-driven mindset — you take a task, figure out how to solve it, and only loop in Marcela when you genuinely need her input, not for every step. Your role is to be an extension of the Operations Manager

Strong judgment and the ability to anticipate needs before being asked

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. 

Comfortable managing multiple priorities and moving parts without dropping the ball

Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive) and comfortable in Excel

Comfortable learning new tools quickly (we use Notion, Slack, and various property management systems)

Reliable, high-speed internet and a dependable computer setup





Bonus (not required, but a plus):

Prior experience in property management or short-term rental/hospitality

Experience with Notion (building or improving SOPs) and Slack

Experience with employee timesheet tracking

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

Experience appending or enriching homeowner/property owner lead lists (finding contact info, verifying details, etc.)





Compensation & Benefits:

Pay: $4.50/hour, 40 hours/week

Health Insurance: Maxicare Silver Plan provided after 6 months of continuous employment

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, overlapping Pacific Time business hours

Long-term role with growth potential as Helios expands into new markets and larger properties





How to Apply

Resume

Please upload it to Google Drive and share the link in your application.

mber.
