title: Influencer Research & Outreach Specialist — Remote
description:
## How does the job work and when do you get paid?



You will receive a specific campaign from us with clear brand requirements, including the target country, platform, creator category, and required performance.



The process is simple:



1. **Find the right influencers** who match the campaign requirements.



2. **Contact the influencers** and offer them the opportunity to work directly with brands.



3. **Help interested influencers sign a service agreement with our company.** From that point, the creator is assigned to you and we can introduce them to relevant brands.



4. **Wait for the brand’s decision.** If a brand is interested in your creator, we connect the brand and influencer directly.



5. **The brand and influencer agree on the details and sign a contract for the campaign.**



6. **Once we receive confirmation that the brand and the influencer you brought in have agreed to work together, your task is considered successfully completed and we pay you within 24 hours.**



### You don’t have to wait for the campaign to be completed



This is an important part of our payment model.



**You don’t have to wait.**



You don’t need to wait:



* for the influencer to publish the sponsored content,

* for the campaign to be completed,

* or for the influencer to receive payment from the brand.



Once we receive confirmation that the brand and influencer have signed an agreement, **we pay you within 24 hours.**



Your job is to find and bring in the right creator. Once your creator is selected by the brand and the collaboration is confirmed, **your job is done and you receive your payment.**



This is a fully remote, flexible, performance-based position. There are no fixed working hours — you d
 when and how much you work.



There is no fixed salary at the beginning. You are paid for successful results, so this position is best for people who prefer flexible, task-based work.



If you're interested, apply and we'll send you the current campaigns, workflow, and payment details.

 Bot API, Anthropic/OpenAI, ElevenLabs, kie.ai, Apify

General automation: content pipelines, SOP/report generators, call-to-action pipelines

Who fits



Has built or extensively used agentic/LLM systems — tool use, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, workflow automation

Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end and verifying it against real production data

Can work from a loosely-specified brief

Not precious about which layer they touch

title: Project Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Lorla is looking for a highly organized, detail-obsessed Project Manager to lead project execution from contract signing through final installation. This is not an administrative support role. The designer owns what we're creating; the Project Manager owns how it gets done. You will bring genuine ownership to every project you touch — anticipating problems before they surface, never letting a detail slip, and holding the broader team accountable to deadlines and commitments.



PROJECT PLANNING & SCHEDULING



Own the project schedule from kickoff through installation and closeout, setting milestones, deadlines, and dependencies.

Lead new client onboarding: send the design questionnaire and "What to Expect" documentation immediately after contract and retainer are received.

Keep projects moving proactively — anticipate issues rather than reacting to them, and escalate early when schedule, budget, or execution risks arise.

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of every project's status.



TEAM COORDINATION & ACCOUNTABILITY

Coordinate tasks and deadlines across designers, procurement/operations, vendors, contractors, and other project partners.

Lead weekly internal team meetings and run or prepare for project-status check-ins.

Ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned, followed through, and completed on time — holding the team accountable.

Give designers the information they need to make decisions without having to chase it down.

Lead communication with outside project partners, including general contractors and architects.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION



Serve as the primary point of contact for all logistics and project-management matters.

Lead weekly client
 updates covering schedule, next steps, outstanding decisions, deliveries, and installations.

Track client approvals and decisions to keep projects on schedule.

Maintain Lorla's high-touch client experience through every operational step of a project.



BUDGET & FINANCIAL TRACKING



Maintain project budgets and monitor actual and committed spend against budget.

Flag potential overruns or scope changes early.

Coordinate proposals, deposits, invoices, change orders, and other financial milestones with the appropriate team member.

Keep project records and financial information current.



PROCUREMENT & VENDOR COORDINATION



Participate in bid-set preparation and the detailed review of labor bids, including related communications and site visits.

Lead the transition from design to procurement, including transition meetings and procurement sheets.

Oversee the purchasing timeline, ensuring approved items move promptly into procurement.

Monitor lead times, backorders, shipping, receiving, damages, replacements, and outstanding vendor issues.

Resolve procurement issues before they become installation-day emergencies.



INSTALLATION & CLOSEOUT



Lead and participate in project site visits, with particular attention to timing and logistics.

Develop and manage installation schedules, confirming products, trades, deliveries, and team readiness.

Maintain punch lists and drive outstanding items to completion.

Ensure final documentation, invoicing, photography, returns/claims, and full project closeout are completed.

Develop client goodbye packets and lead client and vendor gifting.



PROCESS & SYSTEMS



Maintain clean, accurate project information in Lorla's project-management systems.

Develop and maintain repeatable checklists, workflows, and client-facing "What to Expect" documents.

Lead updates to Lorla's operations manual and website content.

Identify recurring bottlenecks or inefficiencies and recommend improvements.



ADDITIONAL SUPPORT



Respond to new client inquiries in the leads inbox.

Support marketing and networking efforts as needed, including social media, events, and gifting.



TOOLS & SYSTEMS



Houzz Pro and Canva. Comfort learning and maintaining structure within project-management and design software is essential.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Fanatical attention to detail — nothing falls through the cracks, ever.

A true sense of ownership over project execution, not just task completion.

A proactive self-starter who drives projects forward and holds others accountable.

Excellent written and verbal communication, especially with high-end clientele.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.



Experience in interior design, architecture, or high-end residential construction project management preferred, but not required.



OUR APPLICATION PROCESS

- Please submit a short <60 sec video sharing your interest in the role and why you applied

- We will invite the top 2-4 applicants to complete a paid work trial, paid at $8/hour (approx 4 hours of time to complete)

- Upon completion of the paid work trial we will invite the next round of candidates to zoom interviews.



Thank you!

title: Meta Ads Manager & Video Editor / Social Media Manager
description:
About Terrafina



Terrafina is a U.S.-based digital marketing company that works with home improvement businesses across the United States.



We help contractors and home service companies grow through paid advertising, lead generation, marketing automation, and content.



We are looking for a full-time Meta Ads Manager & Video Editor / Social Media Manager to join our team long-term.



This is a hands-on role. You will be responsible for helping manage Meta advertising campaigns, editing video ads, analyzing campaign performance, and consistently publishing organic social media content for both Terrafina and our clients.



We are looking for someone who already has experience with Meta Ads Manager and video editing and is comfortable working with multiple client accounts.



Your Main Responsibilities

Meta Ads Management



A major part of this position will be managing and optimizing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for our clients.



You should be comfortable working inside Meta Ads Manager and understanding campaign performance data.



Your responsibilities will include:



Setting up Meta advertising campaigns from start to finish

Creating campaigns, ad sets, and advertisements

Monitoring campaign performance regularly

Reviewing and understanding advertising data

Analyzing CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, frequency, conversion rates, and other important metrics

Identifying winning and underperforming ads

Scaling successful campaigns

Adjusting campaign budgets

Testing new advertisements and creatives

Pausing or replacing underperforming creative

Optimizing campaigns based on performance

Setting up retargeting campaigns

Managing audiences

Setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixels

Configuring conversion tracking

Testing that leads and conversions are being tracked properly

Checking attribution and tracking issues

Helping troubleshoot Meta Ads Manager problems

Maintaining organized campaign structures and naming conventions

Preparing campaign performance reports

Making recommendations for improving campaign performance



We are specifically looking for someone who understands that Meta Ads management is more than simply launching campaigns.



You should be able to look at campaign data, understand what is happening, identify potential problems, and make intelligent optimization decisions.



You will receive direction on our offers, marketing strategies, and goals, but we want someone who can increasingly take ownership of campaign management and optimization.



Video Editing for Advertising

Business owners

Contractors

Customers

Employees

UGC creators

Job sites

Client projects

 and Instagram.

Improving pacing

Improving viewer retention

We are not simply looking for someone who can make a video look good.



We want someone who understands that an advertising video needs to capture attention, maintain attention, communicate an offer, and generate leads or appointments.



Experience editing direct-response ads is highly preferred.



Organic Social Media Management



You will also help us consistently publish organic social media content.

Responsibilities will include:

Posting Instagram Reels

Posting
 content

Procurement & Logistics Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)

About the Role

We are a dynamic and fast-growing company looking for a Procurement & Logistics Coordinator to support day-to-day purchasing and vendor coordination across multiple active projects.



This is an execution-focused, detail-oriented role. You will be responsible for keeping purchasing moving, vendors accountable, and tracking logs accurate — all while working directly with our Operations Lead.



The right person for this role owns their work end to end. You don't wait to be told when something is off — you catch it early, communicate it clearly, and follow through until it's resolved.



No FF&E background is required. What matters most is that you have hands-on, end-to-end purchasing experience — and that you were the one doing the work, not just overseeing it.



What You'll Do

Procurement & Purchasing

Prepare and issue purchase orders for FF&E and OS&E items once selections and budgets are approved

Coordinate pricing, lead times, quantities, and specifications with vendors and manufacturers

Support bid comparisons, quote leveling, and value-engineering efforts

Manage high volumes of purchase orders across multiple active projects simultaneously

Ensure all purchasing aligns with approved budgets and project requirements



Vendor & Logistics Coordination

Communicate with vendors to confirm production schedules, ship dates, and delivery details

Coordinate shipments to designated warehouses and confirm receipt

Track order status and proactively flag delays or issues before they impact project timelines

Resolve vendor discrepancies and follow up on outstanding items independently

Collect and organize invoices, confirmations, warranties, and related documentation



Budgeting, Tracking & Reporting

Maintain detailed tracking logs for purchase orders, deliveries, and payments in Google Sheets

Support budget-to-actual reporting throughout the project lifecycle

Keep all records accurate and up to date in internal tracking systems

Assist with project close-out documentation and final reconciliations



Internal Support & Operations

Work closely with the Operations Lead on daily procurement tasks

Support standardized operating procedures for purchasing, tracking, and reporting

Assist with ad hoc operational tasks as project needs evolve



Tools You'll Use

Fohlio — FF&E specifications, selections, and project documentation

Google Workspace — Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail

Notion — internal tracking, documentation, and workflows



What We're Looking For

2–5+ years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain — you must have been personally executing the work, not just supporting or overseeing it

Ability to walk through the full purchasing process end to end: PR, RFQ, PO, pro forma invoice, three-way matching, payment, vendor notification, and delivery

Experience managing high volumes of purchase orders across multiple projects simultaneously

Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel

Experience coordinating with U.S.-based vendors and suppliers

FF&E, furniture, hospitality, real estate, or construction-adjacent background is a strong plus but not required

Highly organized with strong attention to detail and accuracy

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight

Proactive in identifying and resolving issues before they escalate

Dependable, ownership-driven, and committed to follow-through



What We Offer

Full-time, long-term role

Medical stipend after 3 months

Opportunity to grow into expanded responsibility over time

Clear opportunities for growth and professional development

Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment

title: Creative Video Editor & Hook Specialist (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We're looking for a video editor with real creative instinct - someone who can feel what makes an opening pull a viewer in, not just technically execute a checklist.



This isn't only about mechanical clarity cuts - we have tools that speed those up. What sets the right person apart is the part a tool can't do: taste, energy, and judgment, especially in the first 30 seconds of every video. You'll handle the clarity editing too, but the hook is where you'll really prove yourself. If you have an eye for what makes content feel premium and magnetic, keep reading.



About us: We're an established digital agency producing high-volume YouTube content on business automation and tutorials across two active channels, with a consistent and growing publishing schedule. This is a stable, long-term, full-time role - not a one-off gig. You'll work directly with the person who currently edits these videos, learn our exact style, and eventually take the editing load so we can scale. Clear expectations, direct communication, real growth.



This role has three parts. You need to be strong at all three:



1. The Hook (first 20–45 seconds) - this is the artistic part



The opening of every video has to be beautiful, engaging, and pull viewers in immediately. This means:



- Captions placed thoughtfully - well-timed, visually appealing, never covering the wrong thing

- Attention-grabbing visual edits in the first 3–5 seconds

- B-roll layered in to illustrate and emphasize what's being said

- Captions on top of b-roll to reinforce key spoken points

- Zoom effects and behind-the-speaker edits used tastefully throughout

- Clean introduction of the subject/topic



We are NOT looking for over-the-top motion graphics. We're looking for tasteful, artistic, high-retention editing. If you have an eye for what makes an opening feel premium, this is for you.



2. The Full Edit - clarity + precision



This half is about making the video clean, professional, and error-free. Your job on the main body:



Clarity editing:



- Cut retakes, filler words, dead air, and gaps so the video flows and makes sense

- We use a wavelength gap-cutting tool (TimeBolt) to speed this up - you'll either run it yourself and review its output, or use an equivalent tool in your own workflow if you have one that does the same thing

- The end result must be professional-grade: clean, clear, and easy to follow - no awkward cuts, no leftover stumbles



Redaction (zero tolerance - this is reputation-critical):



- Blur the creator's private information shown on screen - home address, personal phone number, personal
 addresses, ID numbers, or any other personal/private details

- Bleep private info if it's spoken aloud - if the creator OR an AI agent/chatbot in the video says his personal information out loud 
, phone, etc.), mute it and add a bleep sound so it can't be heard, and remove/blur it visually if it's also on screen

- Where needed, edit the transcript/captions so private info isn't written out either

- Exception: demo contacts and clearly public-facing business info do NOT need to be hidden - those are already public. This is specifically about the creator's private information.

- We'll give you the exact list of what counts as private during onboarding



Other in-video tasks:



- Add on-screen layouts when the speaker interacts with a voice agent

- Flash awards / b-roll graphics on screen on cue when directed

- A full watch-through before delivery to confirm nothing was missed



Critical: Missing a single un-blurred private detail, un-bleeped spoken
/phone number, or clipped word is not acceptable. This content goes out publicly, and accuracy protects the creator's privacy and our reputation. We review every video - but we need someone we can eventually trust to get it right the first time.



Style matching: We have an established editing style. A big part of this role is learning it well enough that viewers can't tell where our current editor stops and you begin. We'll give you reference videos to study and match.



3. The Thumbnail - the click-driver



Every video you edit, you also create the thumbnail for. This is a core part of the role, not an add-on. You'll be set up for success:



- We provide the exact prompts we use, plus a "things to know about thumbnails" style guide

- We provide access to AI image generation

- Your job is to produce a scroll-stopping, on-brand thumbnail that matches our established look - strong composition, clear focal point, readable text, the right facial expression/emotion

- We want one person owning the full visual output of each video - edit AND thumbnail - so the look stays consistent end to end



HARD SKILLS REQUIRED

- Advanced video editing in a professional tool of your choice (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, CapCut, etc. - we care about the quality of your work, not which software you use)

- Thumbnail design - strong sense of composition, focal point, readable text, and eye-catching layout (AI tools and our prompts/style guide provided)

- Strong sense of visual design and pacing - especially for short, high-retention hooks

- Caption timing and placement with zero spelling/grammar errors

- Comfort with b-roll, zoom effects, text overlays, and simple on-screen layouts

- Clarity editing - cutting retakes, filler words, and gaps for a clean, professional flow (experience with TimeBolt or a similar gap-cutting tool is a plus)

- Precise censoring/redaction work (blurring, bleeping, transcript editing)

- Strong English listening comprehension - able to catch clipped words and errors by ear



SOFT SKILLS REQUIRED

- Deadline-driven - able to sustain ~10 videos/week once ramped up

- Self-starter - takes direction once, then executes without hand-holding

- Detail-obsessed - you double-check your own work before calling it done

- Coachable - takes feedback and redo requests professionally

- Reliable & communicative - flags problems early instead of guessing

- Consistent - same high quality on video #10 as on video #1



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

- A "checklist-only" editor who executes instructions but brings no creative judgment of their own - we need taste, not just compliance

- Editors who are fast but skip the final watch-through

- Anyone who can't handle detailed redaction/censoring rules precisely

- Anyone uncomfortable being told "redo this, it's not there yet"

- Anyone looking for a short-term or part-time gig



WHO THIS IS FOR

- A skilled editor who takes pride in artistic, premium-feeling work

- Someone who wants a stable, long-term, full-time home

- Someone who can be trusted with precise, reputation-critical detail work

- Someone excited to learn and match an established style



WORKLOAD & SCHEDULE

- Target output: ~10 videos per week once fully ramped (phased ramp-up in the first few weeks)

- Full-time role - but we do not track hours. We care about output and quality, not clock time. Get the work done to standard and manage your own schedule.





TO APPLY



1. Put "AHOY [Your Name]" in the subject line, in all caps. Applications without this will not be reviewed - it's our first check that you read carefully.



2. In the body, put your answer to this question between the lines >>> START > END

title: Production VA (YouTube Animation Workflow)
description:
About the Role

I’m building a small network of educational YouTube channels with a consistent weekly publishing schedule.

 This is not a one-off gig or short-term experiment.

I’m looking for a detail-oriented Production VA to support a repeatable animation workflow. The role starts part-time and is designed to grow into full-time as production ramps across channels.

If you like clear processes, checklists, and delivering clean work on time, this role will be a good fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

Your responsibilities will focus on execution and quality control, not creative decision-making.



Core Tasks

Generate voiceover files using provided scripts and voice settings

Perform pre-QA on voiceover files (accuracy, pacing, missing lines)

Organize and upload files using clear naming conventions

Review generated animation videos using a QA checklist

Flag errors clearly and accurately (do not “fix creatively”)

Communicate issues early and clearly



All creative direction, scripts, titles, thumbnails, and YouTube uploads are handled by me.



What This Role Is Not

Not creative writing or script editing

Not thumbnail design

Not posting to YouTube

Not managing the animation tool directly

Not trend-chasing or viral guessing



This role is about precision, reliability, and consistency.





Schedule & Growth Path

Starts at 15~20 hours per week

Work is ongoing and structured

My goal is to move the right person to full-time (40 hrs/week) within 1–2 months as production increases

Weekly pay and regular communication



I prefer to start with a trial period to ensure the workflow fits both of us.



What I’m Looking For

You’re a good fit if you:

Follow instructions carefully

Use checklists or QA steps naturally

Catch mistakes before they reach the final stage

Respect deadlines and communicate early if something is unclear

Are comfortable with repetitive, process-driven work

Prefer long-term, stable roles over short-term gigs



This role is not a good fit if you:

Prefer creative freedom over structure

Skip QA steps

Miss deadlines or over-explain late delivery

Change instructions “to improve things” without approval



Pay

$4-5/hour, depending on experience

Paid consistently and on time

Increases tied to responsibility and reliability (not vague promises)



How to Apply (Important)

To apply, please follow these instructions exactly:

Start your application with the word PIPELINE

In one sentence, describe how you prevent mistakes in repetitive work

Briefly list any experience with voiceover tools, QA, or production workflows

Final Note

I’m building this carefully and intentionally.

I value long-term working relationships, clear expectations, and mutual respect.

If you enjoy structured work and want to grow with a small, focused team, I’d like to hear from you.

title: Business Manager
description:
Job Description: Virtual Business Manager

September 2026

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote



Reports To: Executive Director

Location: Remote



Position Summary

I am seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Business Manager to provide day-to-day administrative, operational, client, fundraising, marketing, event, and reporting support.

This position is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision.

The Business Manager will help keep my organization organized and moving forward by managing administrative systems, maintaining client and donor information, supporting communications and marketing, assisting with fundraising campaigns, coordinating event activities, maintaining organizational records, and completing grant reporting.

The ideal candidate is a "get-it-done" person who does not need to be reminded repeatedly about assigned tasks and who will identify problems and opportunities and bring solutions to the Executive Director.



Key Responsibilities

1. Administrative & Business Management

• Print and organize monthly/quarterly reports as needed.

• Maintain organized electronic business records.

• Assist staff with routine administrative tasks.

• Create labels, flyers, forms, notices, signs, and other office materials.

• Prepare documents and materials for staff meetings, programs, and events.

• Maintain calendars, deadlines, and recurring administrative tasks.

• Assist with general office organization and administrative projects.

• Follow established organizational procedures and maintain confidentiality.

2. Website Management

• Make routine website updates as requested.

• Add or remove program information, announcements, events, documents, and other content.

• Update website forms, links, images, and basic content as necessary.

• Identify outdated or incorrect information and bring it to the Executive Director's attention.

• Respond to website inquiries and route requests to the appropriate staff member.

3. Social Media & Marketing

• Create and schedule weekly social media posts.

• Maintain a consistent social media presence.

• Develop simple graphics, flyers, announcements, and promotional materials.

• Repurpose organizational content for social media.

• Promote programs, events, fundraising campaigns, community activities, and organizational accomplishments.

• Assist with maintaining a monthly or quarterly content calendar.

• Monitor basic engagement and provide the Executive Director with updates when appropriate.

4. Client & Contact Management

• Maintain and update client information in HubSpot.

• Maintain and update donor and contact information in Givebutter.

• Ensure client and donor records are accurate and organized.

• Enter new contacts and update existing records.

• Track client follow-ups and communication.

• Create and send client follow-up communications.

• Identify incomplete or outdated records and correct them.

• Maintain appropriate documentation of communications and follow-ups.

5. Donor & Fundraising Support

• Create and send donor communications and fundraising campaigns.

• Assist with developing donor campaign content.

• Schedule fundraising
s and communications.

• Maintain donor information in Givebutter.

• Send donor acknowledgments and follow-up communications as directed.

• Help promote fundraising campaigns through
, social media, and the website.

• Track basic campaign results and provide reports to the Executive Director.

• Help maintain consistent communication with donors throughout the year.

6. Website
 & Customer Communication

• Monitor organizational website
 inquiries.

• Respond to routine questions in a timely and professional manner.

• Forward specialized or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate staff member.

• Track inquiries requiring follow-up.

• Ensure that website inquiries do not go unanswered.

• Maintain professional and compassionate communication with clients, donors, partners, and community members.

7. Annual Event Support

Assist the Executive Director and team with planning and organizing the organization's annual event.

Responsibilities may include:

• Maintaining an event planning checklist and timeline.

• Contacting potential sponsors.

• Sending sponsorship information and follow-up communications.

• Following up with potential sponsors.

• Maintaining a sponsor and participant tracking list.

• Recruiting event participants, vendors, community partners, and supporters.

• Sending invitations and event communications.

• Creating event flyers and promotional materials.

• Assisting with registration and participant communications.

• Coordinating administrative details leading up to the event.

• Maintaining sponsor commitments and documentation.

• Assisting with post-event follow-up and acknowledgments.

8. Insurance & Organizational Records

• Help maintain current organizational insurance documentation.

• Organize insurance certificates, policies, renewal information, and related records.

• Maintain a calendar of insurance renewal dates.

• Notify the Executive Director of upcoming renewals or missing documentation.

• Request updated certificates or documents when authorized.

• Keep insurance files organized and easily accessible.

Note: The employee will maintain and organize insurance records but will not make insurance coverage decisions or provide insurance advice.

9. Graphic Design & Staff Support

• Create professional flyers for programs, events, staff announcements, and community outreach.

• Create basic promotional materials and informational handouts.

• Create labels, signs, certificates, forms, and other materials requested by staff.

• Maintain consistency with organizational branding.

Familiarity with Claude, Eleven Labs, CapCut, etc., preferred.

Success in this position means the Executive Director can confidently delegate administrative and operational responsibilities and know that they will be completed without repeated reminders.

The successful employee will help the organization:

title: AI Search & Visibility Specialist (GEO + SEO)
description:
— This is NOT a traditional SEO role. Please read carefully before applying. —



About the Role

Search has fundamentally changed. Buyers no longer just Google — they ask ChatGPT, query Perplexity, and rely on Google AI Overviews to make decisions. At Calimingo Pools, a luxury pool design and construction company based in Southern California, we want to be the brand AI recommends when someone starts dreaming about their backyard.

We're hiring an AI Search & Visibility Specialist who lives at the intersection of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and traditional search. You understand how large language models retrieve, rank, and cite information — and you know how to get a brand into those answers. Traditional SEO is your foundation, not your ceiling.

This is a freelance, remote role with real ownership over how Calimingo is discovered across every search surface — from Google rankings to AI-generated responses.



?? Who This Role Is NOT For



Candidates who only know traditional SEO and have never worked with AI search platforms

Candidates who cannot name the difference between how Google indexes content vs. how an LLM retrieves and cites it

Candidates who have not actively used tools like Perplexity, ChatGPT, or Google AI Overviews as part of their professional work





What You'll Do



Own Calimingo's full search visibility strategy — from Google rankings to AI-generated answers

Conduct GEO and SEO audits covering AI discoverability, citation potential, technical health, and content structure

Optimize pages and content for LLM readability — answer-first formats, clear heading hierarchies, passage-level clarity that AI engines can extract and cite

Build topical authority and entity signals so both search engines and AI tools associate Calimingo with luxury pools, pool design, and outdoor living

Implement schema markup (FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization) for rich results and AI citation

Monitor and grow Calimingo's citation presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and Gemini

Pursue earned media placements — directories, review platforms, editorial features — that strengthen both backlinks and AI multi-source authority

Manage technical search fundamentals — crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, site architecture

Publish and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress

Report monthly on organic rankings, AI citation frequency, and share of voice vs. competitors





Must-Have Skills



Hands-on GEO experience — you have actively worked to get brands cited in AI-generated answers, not just read about it

Working knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — you understand why it matters for brand visibility

Fluency with AI platforms — you regularly use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini as professional tools, not just casually

AI visibility tracking — experience with tools like Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar

Traditional SEO foundation — keyword research, on-page optimization, link building, technical audits

Schema markup — FAQPage, Product, Article, Organization

Search tools — Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console

WordPress — confident navigating, editing, and publishing on a live website

Content strategy — semantic architecture, entity-based strategy, topical authority building





Nice to Have



Digital PR and earned media experience

Knowledge graph and E-E-A-T optimization

Familiarity with agentic search (OpenAI Operator) and agent-driven discovery

Experience with home improvement, construction, luxury goods, or lifestyle brands

title: Technical Drafter
description:
About the role

Calimingo Pools builds luxury custom pools and outdoor living spaces throughout Los Angeles and Orange County. Every project goes through a permitting process — and we need someone who can take raw site data and designer intent and turn it into clean, accurate, permit-ready drawings that actually get approved.



This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the Philippines. You'll work directly with our U.S.-based design and engineering team, managing the full drafting lifecycle from blank site plans to final HOA and building department submissions. Strong rendering skills are a real advantage here — our clients expect drawings that are both technically precise and visually impressive.



Open to candidates from:



Landscape Architecture

Civil Engineering

Structural Engineering

Architecture

Drafting & Design Technology

What matters most is your ability to produce accurate technical drawings and high-quality renders — not the specific degree on your diploma.



What you'll do

- Produce complete plan sets — site plans, section drawings, structural details, and working drawings ready for building permit submittal and HOA approval.

- Create high-quality renders — produce visually polished presentation drawings and 3D renders that clearly communicate design intent to clients and reviewers.

- Convert site measurements into blank site plans — clean, accurate base drawings the design team can build on.

- Coordinate with the design and engineering team — gather structural requirements and design intent from our U.S.-based team to ensure drawings are complete and buildable.

- Research zoning and code requirements — confirm setbacks, easements, and local restrictions before designs are finalized to avoid costly revisions.

- Support the permit process — communicate with city building departments and HOA offices via
 and online portals to help move permits forward.

- Track project progress — update our project management software to keep clients and office staff informed across multiple active projects.



Must-haves

Strong hands-on CAD proficiency — AutoCAD, SketchUp, or equivalent

Proven ability to create accurate 2D technical drawings and plan sets

Good rendering skills — 3D visualization or presentation-quality output

Detail-oriented with a strong sense of accuracy and spatial understanding

Good written and spoken English communication skills

Reliable internet, dedicated home workspace, and available for PST overlap

Self-directed — able to manage tasks independently without micromanagement



Nice to have

Experience with pool, hardscape, or outdoor living construction drawings

Familiarity with U.S. building permit or HOA submittal processes

Experience with Lumion, Enscape, V-Ray, or similar rendering software

Previous remote work with a U.S.-based client or employer

Familiarity with project management tools (Buildertrend, Asana, or similar)

Ability to read and interpret structural or civil engineering plans



What reliability looks like to us

Responds promptly

Replies within a reasonable window during agreed working hours

Meets deadlines

Delivers on time and flags issues early — not at the last minute

Takes ownership

Tracks their own tasks without needing to be chased

Communicates clearly

Keeps the team updated and asks smart questions when stuck



If this is you, send your CV alongside with your Portfolio or work samples — technical drawings, site plans, and renders (include both if you have them)

What you'll do

- Prepare detailed CAD drawings — site plans, section drawings, structural details, and full working plan sets ready for permit submittal.

- Coordinate with our US-based designers and structural engineers to gather all information needed to complete permit packages and HOA submittals.

- Convert raw job-site measurements into clean, accurate blank site plans for the design team to work from.

- Research city planning and zoning requirements (setbacks, easements, code requirements) to ensure designs are buildable before work begins.

- Communicate with California city building departments and HOA offices (via
, phone, and online portals) to expedite permit approvals.

- Log and update project progress in our project management system, keeping clients and office staff consistently informed across multiple active projects.

- Manage revision cycles and respond to plan check corrections from city departments until permits are approved.
